AI.method: 在大规模团簇与并行回火蒙特卡洛中模拟固定振幅符号模型；比较同手性平移壁与变手性壁的能量代价；并用有限尺寸标度的振幅分辨Ginzburg–Landau理论研究相是否在振幅弛豫下存活。
AI.result: 发现直接熔化与两阶段熔化两种区域。两阶段区中平移畴壁先增殖，恢复平移对称但保留长程时间反演奇序；M点关联短程。两阶段区出现在最低能变手性壁仅比同手性平移壁贵约12%–13%时，且中间相在振幅弛豫下稳定存在。
AI.conclusion: 结果给出残余环流序的定量畴壁判据，以及无需长程环流布拉格序即可破缺时间反演的涨落路径，为kagome金属中报道的时间反演奇响应提供可能的热力学框架。

title: Highly uniform first-electron position in qubit arrays fabricated on dedicated QSOI(R) 300mm commercial platform
summary: We report progress toward the development of a quantum silicon-on-insulator (QSOI(R)) technology compatible with 300mm CMOS fabrication and adapted from the 28nm Fully-Depleted SOI (28nm FD-SOI) platform for scalable quantum computing. We compare quantum devices fabricated with standard 28nm FD-SOI and QSOI(R) technologies, and show striking improvements of room temperature electrostatic properties of the individual device. Moreover, the QSOI(R) technology has significantly reduced the device variability and the dispersion of device properties at the wafer level. Transistor metrics are reproduced by TCAD simulations showing that the electrostatics of the devices behave as expected for QSOI(R) technology. Wafer-scale measurements at sub-2K show reproducible quantum dots down to the few-electron regime with 69\% yield for successful charge detection of the first electron and a dispersion of the first electron position of $\mathrm{\pm 35 mV}$ over 377 quantum dots. These results establish QSOI(R) as a promising platform for CMOS-compatible quantum device co-integration.

AI.tldr: 该文报告了与300mm CMOS工艺兼容的量子SOI（QSOI）技术，基于28nm FD-SOI平台，在器件静电特性、变异性及量子点一致性上取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 为实现可扩展量子计算，需要与CMOS工艺兼容的量子器件平台。作者旨在改进标准28nm FD-SOI技术，开发QSOI技术以提升器件性能与一致性。
AI.method: 对比标准28nm FD-SOI与QSOI技术制备的量子器件，测量室温静电特性与晶圆级器件变异性，并用TCAD仿真验证静电行为；在sub-2K下进行晶圆级测量评估量子点。
AI.result: QSOI器件室温静电特性显著提升，器件变异性和晶圆级性能离散度大幅降低；TCAD仿真与实验结果吻合。sub-2K下377个量子点中首次电子电荷探测良率达69%，首次电子位置离散度为±35 mV。
AI.conclusion: QSOI是一种有前景的CMOS兼容量子器件协同集成平台，适用于可扩展量子计算。

title: Universal 1/f Noise in the Power Spectra of Energy Time-series in Solvated DNA Dynamics
summary: We investigate energy fluctuations of solvated DNA in three conformations: G-quadruplex, Hairpin, and Duplex. Our comprehensive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations demonstrate that the time-series of interaction energies for DNA self, DNA-water and DNA-ion show 1/f noise with a universal decay exponent $β\simeq 0.90$. We show that DNA topology and structural rigidity modulate its dynamic coupling with the surrounding hydration shell and mobile counter-ions. This coupling critically shapes the 1/f noise profile: DNA self energies in flexible structures (G-quadruplex, Hairpin) display pronounced low-frequency modes absent in the rigid Duplex. These findings reveal how the interplay between DNA topology and environmental coupling governs different stochastic behavior in biologically relevant forms of DNA.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟，揭示三种构象DNA相互作用能量呈现普遍的1/f噪声（β≈0.90），并发现DNA拓扑与环境耦合共同调控其随机动力学行为。
AI.motivation: 探究DNA拓扑结构和刚性如何影响其与周围水化层及移动反离子的动态耦合，并理解这种耦合如何塑造能量的1/f噪声行为。
AI.method: 对三种构象（G-四链体、发夹、双链）的溶剂化DNA进行全面的分子动力学（MD）模拟，分析DNA自身、DNA-水、DNA-离子的相互作用能量时间序列。
AI.result: 三种相互作用能量时间序列均表现为1/f噪声，具有普适衰减指数β≈0.90；柔性结构（G-四链体、发夹）的DNA自身能量呈现明显低频模式，而刚性双链中则缺失。
AI.conclusion: DNA拓扑与结构刚性通过调控其与周围环境的耦合，决定不同的随机（1/f噪声）行为，揭示了生物相关DNA构象中拓扑-环境相互作用的调控机制。

title: The Origin of the Observed Raman Peaks in α-MnTe
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, plus Supporting Information (8 figures, 1 table)
summary: The Raman spectrum of the room-temperature altermagnet $α$-MnTe is reported to contain unassigned peaks at 120(3) cm$^{-1}$ and 140(3) cm$^{-1}$, absent from the predicted phonon spectrum of the material. This has generated considerable debate within the altermagnet community and necessitates urgent resolution. This work establishes that these peaks, together with the 90(5) cm$^{-1}$ peak that matches a theoretically predicted mode, are all extrinsic, originating from elemental tellurium formed during air exposure of the surface. Raman spectra of MBE-grown thin films show that these peaks closely match those of elemental tellurium, emerge soon after air exposure, and are absent in AlO$_x$-capped films. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy shows that air exposure breaks Mn--Te bonds and oxidizes Mn within a minute. Cross-sectional scanning transmission electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy reveals that the oxidation leads to Mn out-diffusion, forming a few-nanometer-thick oxide layer above a buried, Te-enriched region, likely responsible for the anomalous Raman peaks. Additionally, no sample exhibited the 175 cm$^{-1}$ Raman peak which is commonly attributed to MnTe$_2$. The aggressive surface oxidation and associated elemental Te formation in MnTe have important implications for any surface-sensitive and optical characterization of MnTe (and other similar Te-containing materials) involving even the briefest air exposure.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明室温交变磁体α-MnTe中120和140 cm⁻¹的争议Raman峰（以及90 cm⁻¹峰）均为表面暴露空气后生成元素Te所致的外禀峰，175 cm⁻¹峰则未出现。
AI.motivation: α-MnTe的Raman谱中存在理论声子谱无法解释的120和140 cm⁻¹峰，在交变磁体领域引发激烈争论，亟需澄清这些峰的本征性。
AI.method: 结合MBE生长薄膜的Raman光谱（含空气暴露与AlOx覆盖对比）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）以及截面STEM-EDS表征表面化学与结构演变。
AI.result: 这些峰与元素Te谱高度一致，暴露空气后迅速出现，AlOx覆盖样品中缺失；XPS显示空气暴露1分钟内即断裂Mn–Te键并氧化Mn；STEM-EDS揭示Mn外扩散形成数纳米氧化层并留下富Te区；所有样品均未观察到175 cm⁻¹峰。
AI.conclusion: 120、140和90 cm⁻¹峰均为外禀、源于表面氧化形成的元素Te，并非MnTe本征声子；MnTe表面易氧化，对任何涉及空气暴露的表面敏感与光学表征均有重要警示意义。

title: Global Minima of the Thomson Problem in a Disk: A Molecular Dynamics Approach with Fixed Border Charges
summary: We report improved global-minimum configurations for the classical Thomson problem of $N=60$, $61$, $92$, and $99$ repulsive Coulomb charges confined to a disk. By combining the quenched molecular dynamics (QMD) method with the fixed-border heuristic introduced by Amore and Zarate, we systematically obtain configurations with energies $E_{\mathrm{QMD}}(60)=2159.3584240930$, $E_{\mathrm{QMD}}(61)=2237.19264190$, $E_{\mathrm{QMD}}(92)=5358.35353314$, and $E_{\mathrm{QMD}}(99)=6254.83029083$, which improve upon the previously best-known values. For $N=60$, the Voronoi diagram of our configuration differs from the one reported earlier. The symmetries for $N=61$ $(C_{2})$ and $N=99$ $(D_{1})$ are confirmed and are consistent with the known symmetry patterns for these configurations. For $N=92$, whereas the previously reported Voronoi diagram has lower symmetry, our solution exhibits a clear $D_{1}$ (axial) symmetry of defects. The results are highly reproducible across multiple independent runs, providing strong evidence that these configurations are robust global-minimum candidates.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了经典Thomson问题在N=60,61,92,99时的全局最小构型能量。
AI.motivation: 寻找经典Thomson问题（圆盘内库仑电荷）的全局最小构型是长期挑战，已有最优值仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 将淬火分子动力学（QMD）方法与Amore和Zarate提出的固定边界启发式相结合。
AI.result: 得到更低的能量值（如E(60)=2159.3584240930），改进了已知最优值；N=60的Voronoi图与之前不同，N=61(C2)和N=99(D1)对称性得到确认，N=92呈现清晰D1轴向对称性。
AI.conclusion: 多次独立运行结果高度可复现，这些构型是稳健的全局最小候选。

title: Superconductivity at the metal-insulator phase boundary in a bulk nickelate at ambient pressure
summary: The discovery of superconductivity in nickelates has seeded a new field for exploring unconventional superconductivity in transition metal oxides. However, to date superconductivity has only been realized in thin films or under extreme pressure in the bulk. Here we report signatures of superconductivity at ambient pressure in bulk nickelate single crystals of (La1-xPrx)4Ni3O8 and (La1-xYx)4Ni3O8, whose crystal structure comprises interleaving trilayers of square-planar nickel oxide and fluorite-like spacer layers. The parent compound La4Ni3O8 exhibits an insulating ground state, where electrons order into intertwined, insulating charge/spin stripes. Substitution of smaller lanthanide ions disrupts this order, eventually leading to a metallic ground-state. We find that superconductivity emerges in a narrow window proximate to the insulator-metal phase boundary, where both metallic and charge-stripe phases co-exist. The observed low volume-fraction superconductivity is non-percolative, suggesting the prospect of filamentary superconductivity nucleated at the boundary between these phases. However, intergrowth defects that approximate the known infinite layer nickelates are observed in TEM, leaving open the possibility that superconductivity resides here rather than in the trilayer matrix. Remarkably, the electronic phase diagrams of both the Y and Pr series coincide when parameterized by the volume of the fluorite like spacer layers, revealing that this steric parameter profoundly modifies the nickel oxide trilayer electronic structure. Our results identify better understanding of the co-existence region between metallic and charge-ordered phases as a priority for expanding the range of bulk, ambient-pressure nickelate superconductivity and establish spacer-layer engineering as a design tool for exploring this regime of phase competition.

AI.tldr: 在常压块体镍酸盐单晶(La1-xPrx)4Ni3O8和(La1-xYx)4Ni3O8中发现了超导迹象，超导出现在绝缘体-金属相变边界附近、金属相与电荷条纹相共存的窄窗口中，且呈非渗流特征。
AI.motivation: 镍酸盐超导此前仅在薄膜或高压块体中实现，亟需在常压块体中探索超导，并理解其与电荷有序相共存的关系。
AI.method: 合成(La1-xPrx)4Ni3O8和(La1-xYx)4Ni3O8块体单晶，通过小镧系离子替代调控母体化合物的绝缘电荷/自旋条纹序，结合输运测量、TEM和电子相图分析。
AI.result: 超导出现在接近绝缘体-金属相边界的窄窗口，金属相与电荷条纹相共存；超导体积分数低且非渗流，提示可能为相边界处的丝状超导；TEM观察到近无限层镍酸盐的共生缺陷，故超导也可能源于此。以萤石层体积为参数时，Y和Pr两个系列的电子相图重合。
AI.conclusion: 理解金属相与电荷有序相的共存区是扩展常压块体镍酸盐超导的关键；层间间隔层工程可作为调控该相竞争区域的设计手段。

title: Truncated automatic sparse differentiation for machine learning interatomic potentials
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables (7 pages main text). Additional information at https://marcel.science/tasd4mlip
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) learn the mapping from atomic positions to potential energy. The forces, the negative gradient of this energy, drive molecular dynamics and are readily obtained using automatic differentiation. Higher-order derivatives, most notably the Hessian, describe collective motion and allow the direct prediction of experimental observables, but are considered computationally inaccessible for large systems. We suggest a solution: in physical systems, interactions decay with distance, and most MLIPs build on this locality through message passing up to a finite receptive field. This implies both sparsity of higher-order derivatives and their decay with distance. This structure can be exploited using automatic sparse differentiation (ASD). We explain how to compute the sparsity pattern for MLIP derivatives and demonstrate that, for multiple foundation MLIPs, ASD computes full Hessians of large porous materials exactly, but with modest speedups at best. The larger gains come from truncated ASD: discarding small, but nonzero, Hessian entries between distant atoms yields order-of-magnitude speedups with negligible impact on predicted observables.

AI.tldr: 利用MLIP的局部性导致的稀疏/衰减结构，用自动稀疏微分(ASD)精确高效计算大体系Hessian；截断ASD可实现数量级加速且对预测观测影响可忽略。
AI.motivation: MLIP的高阶导数(如Hessian)能描述集体运动并直接预测实验观测，但对大体系通常被认为计算上不可行。物理系统中相互作用随距离衰减，MLIP通过有限感受野的消息传递体现局部性，因此高阶导数具有稀疏性和随距离衰减的结构，值得加以利用。
AI.method: 提出自动稀疏微分(ASD)，说明如何计算MLIP导数的稀疏模式，并据此利用稀疏性；进一步提出截断ASD，丢弃远距离原子间微小但非零的Hessian元素。
AI.result: 对多个基础MLIP，ASD能精确计算大多孔材料的完整Hessian，但加速有限(至多中等)。截断ASD带来更大收益：获得数量级加速，且对预测观测量的影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 利用MLIP局部性带来的高阶导数稀疏与衰减结构，ASD可精确计算大体系Hessian；截断ASD在几乎不损失精度下实现数量级加速，使Hessian计算对大体系变得可行。

title: Fractional quantum spin Hall crystals from hidden density-wave order
summary: Broken symmetry and topology are distinct descriptions for how matter organizes itself. Here, we propose one gives rise to the other. A mixed singlet-triplet $d$-density wave, which is a particle-hole condensate, has a hidden bond order that breaks translation symmetry and generates a time-reversed pair of Chern bands, without producing conventional charge or spin density order. At fractional fillings with odd denominators, finite size exact diagonalization studies show how repulsive interactions can transform this symmetry-broken topological state into a fractional quantum spin Hall liquid. Its opposite chiralities produce a crossed response in which charge flux transports spin, and spin flux transports charge. The same setting also reveals what borders such a phase. Strong interspin coupling and increasingly dilute fillings favor charge order and make residual band dispersion decisive, while at half filling, the spin-decoupled limit gives a homogeneous correlated liquid with signatures consistent with the physics of a composite Fermi liquid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出破缺对称性与拓扑之间存在因果关系：一种混合单-三重态d密度波（粒子-空穴凝聚体）隐藏的键序能够破缺平移对称性并产生时间反演成对的陈能带，从而由对称性破缺"涌现"出拓扑。
AI.motivation: 破缺对称性与拓扑通常被视为描述物质自组织方式的两种独立机制。作者希望探究二者之间是否存在更深刻的联系，即是否一种机制能够产生另一种。
AI.method: 提出混合单-三重态d密度波（粒子-空穴凝聚体）模型，该态具有隐藏键序，破缺平移对称性并生成时间反演成对的陈能带，但不产生常规电荷或自旋密度序。采用有限尺寸严格对角化方法，在奇数分母的分数量子填充下研究排斥相互作用的影响。
AI.result: 排斥相互作用可将该对称破缺拓扑态转变为分数量子自旋霍尔液体。其相反手性产生交叉响应：电荷流输运自旋、自旋流输运电荷。此外，强自旋间耦合和稀释填充有利于电荷序，使残余能带色散起决定作用；半填充下自旋解耦极限给出均匀关联液体，其特征与复合费米液体物理一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明对称性破缺可产生拓扑，并揭示了该拓扑相周围的相边界及不同极限下（电荷序、复合费米液体）的竞争物理，为破缺对称性与拓扑的统一描述提供了新视角。

title: Plasmons in twisted bilayer graphene across dispersive and flat bands
summary: The dynamical dielectric response of twisted bilayer graphene is explored in large-angle dispersive-band and small-angle quasi-flat-band regimes using time-dependent density-functional theory within the random-phase approximation. At the reference bilayer-graphene interlayer distance, weak coupling in the largest-angle structures preserves Dirac dispersions and the intrinsic $π$ plasmon. Electron doping activates a two-dimensional Dirac plasmon with energies obeying approximate geometric twist-angle scaling, while acoustic-like branches remain embedded in the single-particle continuum. The prohibitively large first-magic-angle supercell is represented by a tractable cell with its interlayer separation reduced to the angle-dependent magic distance, where four quasi-flat bands emerge around the Fermi level. Their partial occupation produces a dispersive low-energy plasmon-like excitation without a clear dielectric zero at resonance. A distinct interband plasmon is instead identified, supported by transitions involving the quasi-flat manifold and neighboring high-density-of-states regions. Band-energy rescaling places its characteristic energy in the mid-infrared range of interband collective excitations measured near the magic angle.

AI.tldr: 本文用TDDFT-RPA方法研究大角度和小角度扭转双层石墨烯的介电响应，揭示大角度下存在Dirac等离激元并遵循角度标度律，小角度下出现由准平带支持的新型带间等离激元。
AI.motivation: 探索扭转双层石墨烯在不同扭转角下的动态介电响应，特别是小角度准平带区域的集体激发行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 基于含时密度泛函理论（TDDFT）结合随机相位近似（RPA），分别在大角度色散带和小角度准平带区域计算介电响应；用角度依赖的magic距离缩减层间距以模拟首个魔角超胞。
AI.result: 大角度下保持Dirac色散和本征π等离激元，电子掺杂激活二维Dirac等离激元并近似遵循扭转角几何标度；小角度下四个准平带部分占据产生无极点的色散型低能等离激元样激发，并识别出准平带与高态密度区跃迁支持的带间等离激元，其能量经重标度后落在中红外范围。
AI.conclusion: 扭转角显著调控双层石墨烯的等离激元性质，小角度魔角附近的带间集体激发可解释实验观测到的中红外等离激元。

title: Khinchin's ergodicity and typicality in statistical mechanics
summary: The formulation of statistical mechanics in terms of ensembles, originally proposed by Gibbs, has proved to be extremely effective in describing the equilibrium state of many-particle systems, in the most diverse contexts (critical phenomena, quantum mechanics, biophysics, just to mention a few). The reasons of this success are still debated, and the connection between dynamics and probability in large systems remains somehow elusive. Indeed, in order to derive the main results of equilibrium statistical mechanics, strong assumptions on the ergodicity of the dynamics are usually required. Nonetheless, empirical observations seem to suggest that the predictions of the theory hold true even when such assumptions are not verified. In this paper we reconsider the point of view put forward by Khinchin, stating that the only relevant ingredients for the validity of statistical mechanics are the large number of degrees of freedom in the system and the choice of extensive observables, irrespectively of the details of the microscopic dynamics. In particular, the presence of dynamical chaos is not required. To this aim, we discuss some analytical and numerical results on a couple of classical integrable systems, the harmonic chain and the Toda model, showing that many important features predicted by equilibrium statistical mechanics, as for instance Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution, are found even in absence of chaos.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视Khinchin的观点：统计力学的有效性仅依赖于系统的大自由度和可观测量的广延性，而非动力学的遍历性或混沌，并通过可积系统（谐振链与Toda模型）的解析与数值结果加以验证。
AI.motivation: Gibbs系综方法在平衡态统计力学中极为成功，但其成功原因仍有争议：通常推导平衡统计力学主要结果需要动力学的遍历性等强假设，而经验观察却表明即使这些假设不成立，理论预测依然有效。因此需要重新审视动力学与概率之间的联系。
AI.method: 作者采纳Khinchin的观点，认为统计力学成立的关键要素是系统的大自由度数目与广延可观测量的选择，而非微观动力学细节，且不要求动力学混沌。为此，他们讨论了两个经典可积系统——谐振链和Toda模型的解析与数值结果。
AI.result: 在谐振链和Toda模型这两个可积系统中，即使在缺乏混沌的情况下，仍能发现平衡态统计力学所预言的许多重要特征，例如Maxwell-Boltzmann分布。
AI.conclusion: 统计力学的有效性并不依赖于动力学的遍历性或混沌，而主要源于大自由度与广延可观测量，这支持了Khinchin的观点。

title: ALIGNN 2.0: A Unified Line-Graph Neural Network Framework for Materials Screening, Force Fields, Inverse Design, Spectroscopy, and Microscopy
summary: Graph neural networks are central to materials property prediction and machine-learning interatomic potentials, yet their reliance on specialized graph libraries hampers portability and reproducibility, and property and force-field models have historically required separate graph pipelines. We present ALIGNN 2.0, a dependency-free, pure-PyTorch reimplementation of the Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network, with the line graph and its batching built from scratch, running on current-generation accelerators and unifying scalar, spectral, tensorial, per-atom, and force-field prediction behind a single graph, a combination that to our knowledge no existing framework provides. Comparing radius and k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) graphs, the wider kNN graph is more accurate for properties while the smoothly varying radius graph is required for energy-conserving molecular dynamics. On the JARVIS-Leaderboard, ALIGNN 2.0 leads on 26 of 30 single-property benchmarks against the original ALIGNN, with large gains for piezoelectric and dielectric maxima, exfoliation energy, moduli, and superconducting Tc. The LAMMPS- and OpenMM-compatible ALIGNN-FF matches leading universal potentials on the Matbench-Discovery and CHIPS-FF benchmarks at a small fraction of their parameters while scaling to hundred-thousand-atom cells. We further use ALIGNN 2.0 as the denoiser in a conditional crystal-diffusion model, where explicit line-graph message passing consistently lowers structural denoising loss. We also show, as work in progress, that an independently diffused, redundant bond-angle state is learnable but does not uniformly improve reconstruction or combine additively with the line graph. Finally, from a single relaxed structure the same framework reconstructs infrared, Raman, optical-dielectric, and neutron spectra in agreement with experiment and DFT, and drives frozen-phonon electron-microscopy image simulation.

AI.tldr: ALIGNN 2.0：纯PyTorch无依赖重实现，统一性质/力场预测，30项基准中26项领先。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN依赖专用图库，影响可移植性与可复现性；且性质预测与力场模型历来需分开的图管线，缺少统一框架。
AI.method: 从零构建线图及其批处理，纯PyTorch实现；对比半径图与kNN图；将标量、谱、张量、逐原子与力场预测统一到单一图中；并以作条件晶体扩散模型去噪器、独立扩散冗余键角态为探索。
AI.result: JARVIS-Leaderboard上30项单性质基准中26项超越原版ALIGNN；kNN图性质更准、半径图适合能量守恒MD；ALIGNN-FF在Matbench-Discovery与CHIPS-FF上以极少参数量匹配领先通用势，可扩展至十万原子级；线图消息传递一致降低去噪损失；单一弛豫结构可重构红外、拉曼、介电、中子谱并驱动静声子电镜模拟。
AI.conclusion: 纯PyTorch统一图框架提升了可移植性并覆盖性质、力场与谱学模拟，线图消息传递有效，但独立键角态未带来一致增益。

title: Vortex-mediated spin current injection into two-dimensional superconductor NbSe2
summary: Injection of pure spin current into superconductors remains a major challenge in superconducting spintronics. Previous studies have primarily focused on spin-polarized quasiparticles and spin-triplet supercurrents, while vortices, ubiquitous topological defects in type-2 superconductors, have been theoretically proposed as alternative carriers of spin angular momentum, yet direct experimental evidence is still lacking. Here, we report the vortex-mediated spin current injection in NbSe2/LiAl2Fe3O8(LAFO) bilayer, an Ising superconductor/ferrimagnetic insulator heterostructure. Under an out-of-plane temperature gradient and an in-plane magnetic field, the NbSe2/LAFO bilayer shows a pronounced thermoelectric peak near the upper critical magnetic field, which has the opposite sign to the conventional vortex Nernst signal observed in a single-layer NbSe2. The sign reversal suggests that the vortex flow induced by spin current injection is opposite to the flow driven by the temperature gradient, which is consistent with theoretical mechanisms including spin-vorticity transmutation and the inverse vortex spin Hall effect. By mapping the field temperature phase diagram, we reveal that the spin current injection occurs exclusively in the vortex liquid phase of NbSe2. Absence of the thermoelectric signal above the superconducting transition temperature further rules out the quasiparticle contribution. Our results establish vortices as efficient carriers of spin information in superconductors, opening a new route towards vortex-mediated superconducting spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该研究报告了NbSe2/LAFO双层结构中由涡旋介导的自旋流注入，为涡旋作为自旋角动量载体提供了直接实验证据。
AI.motivation: 纯自旋流注入超导体是超导自旋电子学的主要挑战。以往研究多关注自旋极化准粒子和自旋三重态超电流，理论上提出涡旋可作为自旋角动量载体，但缺乏直接实验证据。
AI.method: 在Ising超导体/铁磁绝缘体异质结NbSe2/LiAl2Fe3O8(LAFO)双层中，施加面外温度梯度和面内磁场，测量热电信号，并绘制场-温相图。
AI.result: 在上临界磁场附近观察到显著热电峰，其符号与单层NbSe2中常规涡旋Nernst信号相反，表明自旋流注入引起的涡旋流方向与温度梯度驱动方向相反，与自旋-涡度转换及逆涡旋自旋霍尔效应理论一致。相图显示自旋流注入仅发生在涡旋液相，且在超导转变温度以上无信号，排除准粒子贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立涡旋为超导体中高效自旋信息载体，为涡旋介导的超导自旋电子器件开辟新途径。

title: Molecular Geometry Understanding Has Unintendedly Emerged in Frontier Large Language Models
comment: 28 pages, 3 figures, 6 extended data figures. Supplementary Information included. Code and data available at https://github.com/TheorChemGroup/LLMConfBench
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have already shown strong capabilities in solving complex chemical problems expressed in natural language. Yet, many tasks performed by chemists require understanding of 3D structures of chemical compounds and reasoning about them -- abilities, which, to the best of our knowledge, were neither intended by LLM developers nor tested in contemporary models. Such understanding is essential for autonomous molecular discovery and drug development, which is one of the Holy Grails of AI application to chemistry. We tested this capability in modern LLMs on 810 geometries and DFT energies of 27 small organic molecules. Strikingly, while models released before July 2025 struggled to rank conformers by stability, many recent frontier models, including GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3, and Gemini 3.6 Flash achieved competitive accuracy, outperforming the Universal Force Field, and GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 came very close to a modern GFN-FF force field. Analysis of models' explanations for their rankings suggests that they perform best for molecules with well-defined intramolecular interactions -- hydrogen bonds -- which are well quantified in scientific language; at the same time all models except the two newest -- GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5 -- struggle with molecules governed by loosely defined concepts (e.g., ring strain), where force fields excel, suggesting that the scientific language itself might impose constraints on LLMs. Notably, a model's ability to rank conformers is strongly associated with its performance on scientific, coding, and abstract-reasoning benchmarks, suggesting that it emerged unintendedly from models training on linked but conceptually different tasks. Thanks to this generalization of mere scientific knowledge into understanding molecular structures, current frontier models offer a realistic starting point for AI-driven molecular design.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试了现代大语言模型（LLM）对分子三维结构的理解能力，发现最新前沿模型在构象稳定性排序任务上已接近甚至超越传统力场方法。
AI.motivation: 化学任务常需要理解与推理化合物的3D结构，但这一能力并非LLM开发者的设计目标，也未经当代模型测试；而它是自主分子发现与药物研发的关键。
AI.method: 在810个几何结构与DFT能量、27个小有机分子上测试现代LLM，让其按稳定性对构象排序，并分析模型的解释文本。
AI.result: 2025年7月前发布的模型表现挣扎；近期前沿模型（如GPT-5.6 Sol、Kimi K3、Gemini 3.6 Flash）达到有竞争力的准确率，超越Universal Force Field；GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5接近现代GFN-FF力场。模型在含明确分子内相互作用（氢键）的分子上表现最好，而在由"环张力"等模糊概念支配的分子上普遍较弱（仅两个最新模型例外）。构象排序能力与其科学、编程和抽象推理基准表现强相关。
AI.conclusion: 该能力可能是在训练相关但概念不同的任务时意外涌现的；得益于科学知识向分子结构理解的泛化，当前前沿模型为AI驱动的分子设计提供了现实起点。

title: Pressure induced structural phase transition and magneto-elastic coupling in Eu doped LaCrO$_3$
summary: In this study, we have carried out a detailed high pressure investigation on 5$\%$ Eu doped LaCrO$_3$ (ELCO) using synchrotron X-ray diffraction (XRD), micro Raman spectroscopy, and low-temperature magnetization measurements to correlate the structural and magnetic properties under pressure. The high pressure XRD reveals the orthorhombic to rhombohedral structural phase transition around 10.6 GPa. The high pressure Raman data corroborate this result and indicate that the lattice instabilities associated with the low-frequency soft modes play a crucial role in driving this transition. In addition, a pronounced anomaly in the Raman shift and integrated intensity of several Raman modes is observed around 4.5 GPa. By combining the low-temperature magnetization measurements with the anomalies observed in the XRD and Raman data and by comparing with the similar results in LaCrO$_3$ (LCO), a pressure-induced change in the magnetic ground state to antiferromagnetic ordering is predicted.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高压XRD、拉曼光谱和低温磁化测量研究了5% Eu掺杂LaCrO₃，发现约10.6 GPa发生正交到菱方结构相变，并在约4.5 GPa出现拉曼异常，预测压力诱导反铁磁基态转变。
AI.motivation: 探究5% Eu掺杂LaCrO₃在压力下的结构与磁性关联，理解掺杂和压力如何共同调控其结构相变和磁基态。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射高压X射线衍射（XRD）、显微拉曼光谱及低温磁化测量，对5% Eu掺杂LaCrO₃（ELCO）进行高压研究，并与LaCrO₃（LCO）的结果进行对比。
AI.result: 高压XRD揭示约10.6 GPa处发生正交到菱方的结构相变；高压拉曼数据佐证该结果，表明低频软模相关的晶格不稳定性在驱动相变中起关键作用。此外，多个拉曼模式的位移与积分强度在约4.5 GPa处出现显著异常。结合低温磁化测量及XRD、拉曼异常，并与LCO对比，预测压力诱导磁基态转变为反铁磁有序。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了ELCO中压力驱动的结构相变与磁基态变化之间的关联，约4.5 GPa的异常可能标志磁基态向反铁磁有序的转变，低频软模主导了结构相变。

title: Predictive Structure to Thermal Conductivity Modeling Framework for BEOL Interconnect Stacks in Advanced Technology Nodes Enabled by Extensive Layer Resolved Thermal Measurements
summary: The increasing structural complexity of BEOL interconnect stacks in advanced integrated circuits demands a structure-aware thermal conductivity (\k{appa}) modeling framework. However, generalizable models derived from layer-resolved thermal measurements that quantitatively capture the dependence of \k{appa} on interconnect structures remain lacking, limiting predictive thermal analysis. Here, we establish an experimentally derived, structure-aware \k{appa} modeling framework enabled by time-domain thermoreflectance measurements with ~100 nm depth resolution. Statistical analysis of a compiled dataset comprising over 40 experimentally measured layer-resolved \k{appa} values across diverse BEOL layers reveals a generalizable empirical structure-to-\k{appa} relationship, enabling predictive modeling based on interconnect structure. An intra-layer three-dimensional \k{appa} distribution model based on effective medium theory and realistic layouts further resolves spatial \k{appa} variations within practical interconnect layers. Together, these models establish an experimentally derived, structure-aware \k{appa} modeling framework for predictive and generalizable thermal analysis of advanced interconnect stacks and 3D ICs.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了基于实验的结构感知热导率建模框架，实现先进BEOL互连栈与3D IC的预测性热分析。
AI.motivation: 先进集成电路BEOL互连栈结构日益复杂，但缺乏基于层分辨热测量、可推广且能定量刻画热导率随互连结构变化的模型，限制了预测性热分析。
AI.method: 采用约100 nm深度分辨率的时域热反射测量，统计编译的40余个层分辨热导率数据集，提炼结构与热导率的经验关系；并基于有效介质理论和实际布局，构建层内三维热导率分布模型。
AI.result: 统计分析揭示了可推广的经验性结构-热导率关系，支持基于互连结构的预测建模；层内三维模型进一步解析了实际互连层内的空间热导率变化。
AI.conclusion: 两类模型共同构成基于实验、结构感知的热导率建模框架，可对先进互连栈和3D IC进行预测性、可推广的热分析。

title: Formal Fluctuation-Response Relations for Non-Stationary Systems: The Dynamic Conjugate Variable
summary: Fluctuation-response relations (FRRs) connect the linear response of a system to an external perturbation with properties of spontaneous fluctuations in the unperturbed system. We provide a simple derivation of FRRs for non-stationary dynamics following an almost standard way based on introducing a variable conjugated to perturbation (a dynamic conjugate). The derivation relies solely on the Markovianity of the underlying dynamics, with the only additional assumption that the transition PDF of the process is differentiable with respect to the strength of a constant, time- independent perturbation. The structure of this conjugate variable is however unusual: it is a two-time one, and reduces to a usual single-time conjugate in stationary situations. We show how several known results follow from this approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于"动态共轭变量"的简单方法，推导非平稳动力学下的涨落-响应关系（FRRs）。
AI.motivation: 涨落-响应关系通常用于平稳系统，但非平稳动力学下的FRR推导与结构尚需更简洁、统一的处理。
AI.method: 通过引入一个与微扰共轭的变量（动态共轭），仅依赖动力学的马尔可夫性，并假设跃迁概率密度函数对恒定微扰强度可微，从而推导FRRs。
AI.result: 该共轭变量具有不寻常的"双时间"结构，在平稳情形下退化为通常的单时间共轭变量；由此可复现若干已知结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了理解非平稳FRRs的统一视角，表明其基础仅在于马尔可夫性与可微性假设。

title: Portfolio-Based Constrained Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for Materials Design
summary: Materials discovery and design campaigns can be formulated as constrained multi-objective Bayesian optimization (CMOBO) problems, within which each experimental decision negotiates between two coupled but competing goals: discovering feasible candidates and refining the underlying Pareto front. Here we recast acquisition-function choice as an adaptive policy-selection problem over a portfolio of conventional and feasibility-focused acquisition functions. This was done using two controllers: UCB-Bandit, a modified UCB multi-armed bandit, and Agentic-Switch, a multi-agent decision system driven by a large language model (LLM). Both were evaluated against fixed-policy baselines in silico across five synthetic benchmark functions and two materials design case studies. The adaptive policies performed competitively in terms of both cumulative feasibility count and feasible hypervolume improvement, while each individual acquisition function performed well for only one metric, suggesting that adaptive policies are better suited for constrained materials science problems.

AI.tldr: 将约束多目标贝叶斯优化(CMOBO)的采集函数选择重新表述为自适应策略选择问题，用UCB-Bandit与LLM驱动的Agentic-Switch两种控制器在采集函数组合间切换，在5个合成基准与2个材料设计案例中优于固定策略基线。
AI.motivation: 材料发现与设计可建模为CMOBO问题，每次实验决策需在"发现可行候选"与"精化Pareto前沿"两个耦合且竞争的目标间权衡。单一常规采集函数往往只擅长其中一个指标，固定策略难以兼顾。
AI.method: 把采集函数选择重构为对"常规采集函数+面向可行性的采集函数"组合的自适应策略选择问题，采用两种控制器：UCB-Bandit（改进的UCB多臂老虎机）和Agentic-Switch（由大语言模型驱动的多智能体决策系统）。以固定策略为基线，在5个合成基准函数与2个材料设计案例中进行in silico评估。
AI.result: 自适应策略在累计可行解数量与可行超体积改进两个指标上均表现有竞争力；而各单一采集函数仅在一项指标上表现良好。自适应策略更适合约束材料科学问题。
AI.conclusion: 将采集函数选择视为自适应策略选择，可有效平衡可行解发现与Pareto前沿精化的双重目标，为约束材料设计与发现提供比固定策略更稳健的方案。

title: Generic thermodynamics of condensates with extremely small superfluid density ---Application to UTe$_2$ and hidden second phase transition---
summary:
Motivated by recent experimental findings on UTe$_2$ via NMR and specific heat experiments, we theoretically explore the thermodynamic signatures of condensates with small superfluid density and characterize their physical properties. We identify the hidden superconducting phase $A_2$ composed of spin-up Cooper pairs
  at lower temperature ($T$) and field ($H$) under ambient pressure of UTe$_2$ and show that $A_2$ reappears at higher $H$ for all three principal field directions, $a$, $b$, and $c$-axis. The phase transition lines from the $A_1$ phase with spin down pairs to the $A_2$ phase in the $H$-$T$ plane are all horizontal in common, implying a universal physical origin due to the originating from the magnetic-energy gain of the spin-up pairing state with increasing magnetic field. This multiple-phase diagram is extended to these under pressure ($P$), resulting in a simple picture based on non-unitary spin-triplet pairing symmetry $^3B_{3u}$, which enables us to consistently capture the evolution of the superconducting phases throughout the entire $H$-$T$-$P$ phase space.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论分析UTe₂中低超流密度凝聚态的热力学特征，识别出自旋向上库珀对构成的隐藏超导相A₂，并构建了统一的H-T-P相图。
AI.motivation: 受近期UTe₂的NMR和比热实验启发，探索低超流密度凝聚态的热力学特征及其物理性质，以理解其超导相的多重性和演化规律。
AI.method: 基于非幺正自旋三重态配对对称性³B₃ᵤ的理论框架，分析A₁（自旋向下对）与A₂（自旋向上对）相在磁场-温度平面中的相变行为，并扩展至压力维度。
AI.result: 识别出A₂相在低温低场下存在于UTe₂常压环境，并在三个主轴方向（a、b、c轴）的高场下均重新出现；A₁到A₂的相变线在H-T平面中均为水平，表明源于自旋向上配对态随磁场增强的磁能增益。
AI.conclusion: 基于³B₃ᵤ非幺正自旋三重态配对对称性，可一致地描述整个H-T-P相空间中超导相的演化，为UTe₂多相图提供简洁统一的物理图像。

title: Hydrogen Reorganization in Hot Dense Ammonia
summary: Hydrogen is known to form stable compounds with a variety of simple molecular solids under high pressure. However, ammonia hydride has not been experimentally observed. Here, through a series of laser-heating diamond anvil cell (LHDAC) experiments, we observed the transparent ionic ammonia transformed into an opaque phase above 150 GPa and 1000 K. Raman spectroscopy reveals a pronounced structural change, accompanied by the emergence of two distinct asymmetric H$_2$ vibrons ($ν_1$ and $ν_2$). A new ionic phase produced following thermally induced dissociation and hydrogen reorganization in hot dense ammonia. The combination of experimental results and first-principles calculations identify this phase as the theoretically predicted ionic $P4_12_12$ phase of NH$_7$ , which consists of NH$_4^+$, H$^-$and H$_2$ units. Our results suggest that the formation of ammonia hydrides follows a thermodynamic pathway distinct from those of other H$_2$-containing mixtures, revealing a new ionic transformation pathway driven by hydrogen reorganization in hot dense ammonia.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过激光加热金刚石压砧实验，在150 GPa和1000 K以上首次实验观测到氨氢化物（NH₇）离子相，证实了理论预测的P4₁2₁2结构。
AI.motivation: 氢在高压下能与多种简单分子固体形成稳定化合物，但氨氢化物此前从未被实验观测到，其形成机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用激光加热金刚石压砧（LHDAC）实验，结合拉曼光谱表征与第一性原理计算进行分析。
AI.result: 在150 GPa、1000 K以上，透明离子态氨转变为不透明相；拉曼光谱显示明显的结构变化，出现两个不对称H₂振动模（ν₁和ν₂）。实验与计算共同确认该相为NH₇的离子P4₁2₁2结构，由NH₄⁺、H⁻和H₂单元组成。
AI.conclusion: 氨氢化物的形成遵循与其他含H₂混合物不同的热力学路径，揭示了热致密氨中由氢重组驱动的新型离子转变途径。

title: Tunable flat band on the surface of a rhombohedral kagome ferromagnet
summary: A central goal in the exploration of kagome-based materials is the realization of a flat band that has meV bandwidth and lies close to the Fermi energy. The prevailing assumption is that band flattening originates from destructive hopping processes on the kagome lattice. We perform scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) on the layered kagome ferromagnet Fe$_3$Sn$_2$ and show that it indeed hosts a flat band near the Fermi energy, which is manifested as a sharp peak in the differential tunneling conductance. First-principles slab calculations reveal, however, that this band is flattened not by the destructive interference of intralayer hopping, but by interlayer hopping between rhombohedral-stacked kagome planes in Fe$_3$Sn$_2$, and is confined to the surface layer. This surface band, forming in the vicinity of the Brillouin zone corners $\bar{K}$ and $\bar{K'}$, exhibits rich magnetic-field dependence, including fine structure due to valley-symmetry breaking by rotated Fe moments, as well as a persistent diamagnetic shift associated with orbital magnetic moments, all reproduced by our calculations. Our results, highlighting the crucial role of layer stacking on the band structure of kagome magnets, demonstrate experimentally an alternative mechanism of generating magnetically tunable flat bands in atomically thin volumes of topological magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文通过STM研究层状kagome铁磁体Fe₃Sn₂，发现其费米能级附近存在平带，但该平带源于两层间hopping而非kagome晶格内的相消干涉，且局限在表面层。
AI.motivation: kagome材料研究的核心目标之一是实现带宽为meV量级且靠近费米能级的平带。此前普遍认为平带来自kagome晶格上的相消hopping过程，作者希望验证并揭示真实机制。
AI.method: 对层状kagome铁磁体Fe₃Sn₂进行扫描隧道显微镜（STM）测量，并结合第一性原理slab计算进行分析。
AI.result: STM观测到费米能级附近的平带，表现为微分电导中的尖锐峰。计算表明该平带并非来自层内hopping的相消干涉，而是由Fe₃Sn₂中菱面体堆垛kagome层之间的层间hopping导致，且局限于表面层，形成于布里渊区角点K̄和K̄'附近。该表面带表现出丰富的磁场依赖，包括由旋转Fe磁矩引起谷对称性破缺的精细结构，以及与轨道磁矩相关的持续抗磁位移，均被计算复现。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调层堆垛对kagome磁体能带结构的关键作用，实验证明了在拓扑磁体原子级薄体积中产生磁可调平带的另一种机制。

title: Coplanar Lateral Gating MoS2 on SrTiO3: A Unified Platform for Classical and Quantum Devices
summary: Atomically thin transition-metal dichalcogenides, such as MoS2, offer a promising route to surpass the scaling limits of silicon owing to their excellent electrostatic control and resilience to short-channel effects. Realizing this potential depends critically on gate-stack engineering, where strong gate coupling must be achieved without compromising the pristine two-dimensional interface. Here, we demonstrate a coplanar lateral-gating architecture for MoS2 field-effect transistors fabricated directly on single-crystal SrTiO3. The exceptionally high permittivity of SrTiO3 enhances gate-channel coupling. The coplanar geometry eliminates the need for a separate gate insulator, reducing interface disorder. Owing to the quantum paraelectric nature, the SrTiO3 dielectric constant increases upon cooling, enhancing the gate coupling, leading to a decrease in threshold voltage and subthreshold swing an effect that contrasts with conventional FET architectures. The dielectric-free MoS2 surface, combined with enhanced electrostatic control, makes this architecture a promising platform for low-power two-dimensional electronics and cryogenic quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文在单晶SrTiO3上直接制备共面横向栅极MoS2场效应晶体管，利用其超高介电常数和量子顺电特性实现强栅极耦合与低功耗潜力。
AI.motivation: 原子级薄过渡金属硫属化物（如MoS2）有望突破硅的缩放极限，但实现该潜力关键在于栅极叠层工程，需在不破坏二维界面的前提下实现强栅极耦合。
AI.method: 采用直接在单晶SrTiO3上制备的共面横向栅极结构，无需独立栅极绝缘层，利用SrTiO3的高介电常数增强栅-沟道耦合，并借助其量子顺电特性在降温时提升介电常数。
AI.result: SrTiO3介电常数随降温增大，增强栅极耦合，导致阈值电压和亚阈值摆幅下降，与传统FET行为相反；同时无介电层的MoS2表面减少了界面无序。
AI.conclusion: 该无介电层、强静电控制的架构是低功耗二维电子学和低温量子器件的理想平台。

title: Martingale theory for heat and phase-space contraction in heterogeneous diffusions
summary: We investigate martingale properties of heat dissipated by generic non-equilibrium overdamped Langevin dynamics with multiple dimensions and transport coefficients that may depend explicitly on time and/or space. We find quantitative criteria that establish that heat dissipation may exhibit transient martingale (time-conserved), submartingale (time increasing), and supermartingale (time decreasing) properties in Langevin dynamics with drift coefficients with spatial non-linear dependencies. Furthermore, we reveal a tight link between the heat statistics at stopping (e.g. first-passage) times with that of a functional quantifying the phase-space contraction in the system dynamics. The theoretical results are used to predict the statistical properties of the heat dissipated by a spherical microscopic particle subject to gravity and double-layer forces and hydrodynamically interacting with a rigid wall, whose validity is confirmed by numerical simulations. These results extend the scope of stochastic energetics by revealing a non-trivial relation between heat fluctuations' statistical properties and the non-linear features of non-equilibrium processes.

AI.tldr: 研究多维过阻尼朗格文动力学中热耗散的鞅性质，给出瞬态鞅/下鞅/上鞅的定量判据，并揭示停止时刻热统计与相空间收缩泛函的联系。
AI.motivation: 将随机能量学扩展到非平衡过程非线性特征与热涨落统计性质之间的非平凡关系。
AI.method: 对具有时空依赖输运系数与空间非线性漂移的多维过阻尼朗格文动力学进行鞅性质分析，建立定量判据，并联系停止（首次通过）时刻热统计与相空间收缩泛函。
AI.result: 得到热耗散呈现瞬态鞅（时间守恒）、下鞅（随时间增）和上鞅（随时间减）的判据；用受重力与双层力作用、与刚性壁流体动力学耦合的球形微观粒子的热耗散统计预测验证，数值模拟证实理论。
AI.conclusion: 结果扩展了随机能量学范围，揭示热涨落统计性质与非平衡过程非线性特征之间的非平凡关系。

title: Type-I superconductivity in a quasi-2D topologically nontrivial YbBi$_2$
summary: Intrinsic superconductivity in stoichiometric materials with nontrivial electronic topology remains uncommon, limiting opportunities to investigate how these two phenomena coexist within a single electronic system. Here, we report bulk type-I superconductivity below $T_c$ $\sim$ 0.9~K in YbBi$_2$, a layered rare-earth compound with a nonsymmorphic crystal structure and a quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surface. Thermodynamic and transport measurements establish the superconducting ground state, while quantum oscillations reveal exceptionally light carriers, with a cyclotron mass as low as 0.07 $m_e$, and a nonzero Berry phase of approximately 0.82 $π$. The latter closely matches the calculated value of the corresponding Wilson phase 0.99 $π$ for the corresponding orbit near a symmetry-protected band degeneracy. ARPES measurements show good agreement with key features of the calculated electronic structure, providing complementary experimental constraints on the normal-state band structure. The combination of intrinsic type-I superconductivity, light quasi-two-dimensional carriers, and signatures of nontrivial electronic topology identifies YbBi$_2$ as a distinct stoichiometric platform for investigating superconductivity in a topologically nontrivial electronic environment.

AI.tldr: YbBi₂是一种层状稀土化合物，实验发现其体相I型超导（Tc约0.9 K），同时能带具有非平凡拓扑特征（Berry相位约0.82π），成为研究超导与拓扑共存的新平台。
AI.motivation: 化学计量比材料中本征超导与非平凡电子拓扑共存的情况罕见，限制了在单一电子体系中研究二者相互作用的机会。
AI.method: 通过热力学与输运测量确定超导基态，利用量子振荡测量载流子性质与Berry相位，结合ARPES和中子-非共面对称结构计算电子结构进行验证。
AI.result: YbBi₂体相为I型超导，Tc约0.9 K；量子振荡显示极轻载流子（回旋质量低至0.07 me）和非零Berry相位约0.82π，接近计算值0.99π；ARPES结果与计算能带结构吻合。
AI.conclusion: YbBi₂集本征I型超导、轻质量准二维载流子与非平凡拓扑特征于一体，是研究拓扑非平凡电子环境中超导行为的理想化学计量比平台。

title: Corner entanglement scaling with projected entangled pair states
summary: Entanglement scaling provides a powerful probe of universal properties at quantum critical points. In two dimensions, contributions originating from a corner-shaped bipartition exhibit a universal scaling, which is determined by the underlying conformal field theory. We develop a method to extract this corner entanglement entropy from projected entangled pair states directly in the thermodynamic limit. When applied to models at a quantum critical point, we show that the corner contribution exhibits scaling with the effective correlation length, in agreement with the hypothesis of finite-entanglement scaling. Our results for the corner coefficients are consistent with other methods, demonstrating the efficiency of our method for diagnosing strongly-correlated quantum critical points in two dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出从投影纠缠对态(PEPS)直接提取角纠缠熵的方法，验证了有限纠缠标度假设，可高效诊断二维量子临界点。
AI.motivation: 纠缠标度是探测量子临界点普适性质的有力工具，二维中角形划分产生的贡献由共形场论决定，但缺乏高效提取手段。
AI.method: 开发一种直接从投影纠缠对态(PEPS)中、在热力学极限下提取角纠缠熵的方法。
AI.result: 应用于量子临界点模型时，角贡献随有效关联长度标度变化，与有限纠缠标度假设一致；角系数结果与其他方法相符。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能高效诊断二维强关联量子临界点。

title: Disorder-induced modulation of the nonlinear Hall effect in Weyl semimetals
summary: We study the effects of impurity scattering on the nonlinear Hall response of Weyl semimetals within the semiclassical Boltzmann approach. We derive the rectified and second-harmonic conductivity tensors for a general momentum-dependent transport relaxation time and evaluate this quantity microscopically for short-range, Gaussian, screened Coulomb, and magnetic impurities. For scalar disorder, the relaxation time is isotropic and chirality independent. The nonlinear Hall response is then determined by the anomalous velocity associated with the Berry curvature, and a finite net response requires energetically inequivalent Weyl nodes to avoid cancellation between opposite chiralities. Polarized magnetic impurities lead to a qualitatively different behavior. We find that interference between the first- and second-order Born amplitudes generates a helicity-dependent anisotropic correction to the relaxation time. This anisotropy changes the tensor structure of the nonlinear Hall conductivity and gives rise to a finite second-harmonic current for suitable orientations of the electric field relative to the impurity polarization. For representative parameters, however, the anisotropic contribution is several orders of magnitude smaller than the dominant isotropic response. These results establish how the microscopic form of impurity scattering enters the nonlinear Hall response of Weyl semimetals through the transport relaxation time.

AI.tldr: 本文用半经典玻尔兹曼方法研究杂质散射对Weyl半金属非线性霍尔响应的影响，微观计算了多种杂质下的弛豫时间，并揭示磁性杂质诱导的各向异性修正。
AI.motivation: 理解杂质散射的微观形式如何通过输运弛豫时间进入Weyl半金属的非线性霍尔响应，尤其是磁性杂质可能带来的定性差异此前不够清楚。
AI.method: 在半经典玻尔兹曼框架下，推导一般动量依赖弛豫时间的整流与二次谐波电导张量，并对短程、高斯、屏蔽库仑及磁性杂质进行微观计算，包含一阶与二阶Born振幅的干涉。
AI.result: 标量杂质给出各向同性、与手性无关的弛豫时间，非线性响应由Berry曲率反常速度决定，需能级不等价的Weyl节点才不抵消；极化磁性杂质通过Born振幅干涉产生依赖螺旋性的各向异性修正，改变张量结构并可在合适电场取向下产生有限二次谐波电流，但代表参数下该各向异性贡献比主导各向同性响应小几个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了杂质散射的微观形式如何经输运弛豫时间影响Weyl半金属的非线性霍尔响应，磁性杂质的各向异性效应在定性上重要但实际量级很小。

title: Grain Boundary Distortion Reorients the Local 4f Easy Axis and Splits Light from Heavy Lanthanides in Nd2Fe14B
summary: The coercivity of rare-earth permanent magnets originates from the crystal field acting on localized 4f electrons, yet how grain boundaries modify the underlying single-ion Hamiltonian remains largely unknown. Here we determine the 4f crystal field in bulk and grain-boundary environments of Nd2Fe14B using embedded multireference electronic-structure calculations for the substitutional series Ce, Pr, Nd, Gd, Tb, and Dy. Grain-boundary distortion produces a crossover across the lanthanide series: the crystal field weakens by up to 36% for light lanthanides but strengthens by about 25% for heavy lanthanides, with Nd marking the crossover. The ground-state doublet of Dy becomes more isolated and axial, whereas Ce exhibits a collapsed low-lying excitation that suppresses anisotropy. The local easy axis rotates from the bulk c axis toward the basal plane, identifying grain-boundary sites as favorable nucleation centers for magnetization reversal. These results provide an atomistic basis for heavy rare-earth grain-boundary diffusion and furnish transferable single-ion parameters for spin-lattice simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文用嵌入多参考电子结构计算，确定Nd2Fe14B体相与晶界环境的4f晶体场，揭示晶界畸变沿镧系产生交叉效应，为晶界扩散与自旋-晶格模拟提供单离子参数。
AI.motivation: 稀土永磁矫顽力源于局域4f电子的晶体场，但晶界如何改变单离子哈密顿量尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对替代系列Ce、Pr、Nd、Gd、Tb、Dy的Nd2Fe14B，采用嵌入多参考电子结构计算，测定体相与晶界环境中的4f晶体场。
AI.result: 晶界畸变沿镧系产生交叉：轻镧系晶体场减弱最多36%，重镧系增强约25%，Nd为交叉点。Dy基态双重态更孤立、更轴向；Ce出现低能激发坍缩，抑制各向异性。局域易轴从体相c轴转向基面，表明晶界位点是磁化反转的有利形核中心。
AI.conclusion: 结果为重稀土晶界扩散提供原子尺度依据，并提供可迁移的单离子参数用于自旋-晶格模拟。

title: Superconductivity in Pb2-xBixPd Single Crystals
summary: Chemical substitution provides an effective route to tune the structural and superconducting properties and to explore the evolution of superconductivity across related materials. In this work, we investigate the effect of Pb/Bi mixing on superconductivity in possible topological superconductors \ch{Pb2Pd} and $β$-\ch{Bi2Pd}, by synthesizing and characterizing single crystals of \ch{Pb_{2-x}Bi_{x}Pd} ($0.2\le x\le1.8$). Increasing Bi content triggers a structural phase transition from non-symmorphic ($I4/mcm$, $x<1$) to layered ($I4/mmm$, $x\ge1$) and induces a monotonic expansion of the lattice parameters. Across the doped range, all superconducting samples behave as weakly-coupled type-II superconductors exhibiting isotropic s-wave superconducting gaps.

AI.tldr: 通过合成Pb_{2-x}Bi_{x}Pd单晶，研究了Pb/Bi混合对超导电性的调控，发现随Bi含量增加发生结构相变（I4/mcm → I4/mmm），所有超导样品均为弱耦合II型超导体、具有各向同性s波超导能隙。
AI.motivation: 化学替代是调控结构与超导性质、探索相关材料中超导演化的有效途径；本文旨在研究Pb/Bi混合对可能的拓扑超导体Pb2Pd和β-Bi2Pd超导电性的影响。
AI.method: 合成并表征Pb_{2-x}Bi_{x}Pd（0.2≤x≤1.8）单晶，通过改变Bi含量考察结构相变与晶格参数变化，并测量其超导性质。
AI.result: 随Bi含量增加，材料从非对称性结构（I4/mcm，x<1）转变为层状结构（I4/mmm，x≥1），晶格参数单调扩大；整个掺杂范围内所有超导样品均表现为弱耦合II型超导体，具有各向同性s波超导能隙。
AI.conclusion: Pb/Bi混合可有效调控Pb2Pd–β-Bi2Pd体系的结构与超导性质，且该体系超导性表现为常规的各向同性s波特征。

title: When Is Kramers-Wannier Duality Invertible?
summary: {\it Kramers-Wannier} duality of the quantum Ising chain is naturally realized as a noninvertible transformation on a finite periodic chain. Upon incorporating appropriate symmetry-twisted sectors, however, the duality can be promoted to an invertible unitary transformation. In this Letter, we classify when the Kramers-Wannier duality admits an invertible realization on a finite Hilbert space. We show that this is determined by the representation of the Ising bond algebra and establish a necessary and sufficient condition in terms of its two central elements. This representation-theoretic criterion unifies the conventional noninvertible realization with invertible constructions involving symmetry-twisted sectors and applies equally to other models with the same underlying bond algebra. As an explicit example, we find an order-disorder duality in a non-trivial realization of the Ising bond algebra that admits an invertible Kramers-Wannier duality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限周期 Ising 链上 Kramers-Wannier 对偶何时可实现为可逆幺正变换，用 Ising 键代数的表示（两个中心元）给出充要条件。
AI.motivation: 量子 Ising 链的 Kramers-Wannier 对偶在有限周期链上通常是非可逆变换，但引入对称扭结部门后可提升为可逆幺正变换。作者希望统一刻画何时存在这种可逆实现。
AI.method: 将 Kramers-Wannier 对偶视为 Ising 键代数表示上的变换，通过分析其两个中心元的表示来分类可逆性，并给出充要条件；同时推广到具有相同键代数的其他模型。
AI.result: 建立了可逆 Kramers-Wannier 对偶的表示论判据，统一了传统非可逆实现与含对称扭结部门的可逆构造；并在 Ising 键代数的一个非平凡实现中找到了序-无序对偶作为显式例子。
AI.conclusion: Kramers-Wannier 对偶是否被有限希尔伯特空间上的酉算子实现，取决于 Ising 键代数表示的两个中心元；该判据为寻找新的可逆序-无序对偶提供了系统框架。

title: Coherent and ultra-low-power EDSR with a flopping-mode spin qubit in germanium
summary: Hole spin qubits in semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) enable high-fidelity all-electric control, but conventional electric dipole spin resonance (EDSR) can require substantial rf drive power at the low magnetic fields that are favorable for qubit coherence and readout. In planar Ge hole spin qubits, this can reach -27 dBm at the device, posing challenges for scalable architectures due to heating and crosstalk. Here, we demonstrate a flopping-mode (FM) qubit in Ge, where a single spin is delocalized in a double QD, combining first-order protection against charge noise with exceptionally efficient electric driving. By mapping out coherence sweet-spots as a function of magnetic field orientation we achieve $T_2^*= 1.4μ\mathrm{s}$, $T_2^{\mathrm{Hahn}}= 11.5 μ\mathrm{s}$, $T^{φ, \mathrm{CPMG32}}_2= 130 μ\mathrm{s}$, and $T_1= 226 μ\mathrm{s}$, and a single-qubit gate fidelity of up to 99.76$\%$ for a gate time $t_{Xπ} = 88$ ns. Importantly, these results are obtained at a nearly in-plane magnetic field of 5 mT using only -52 dBm drive power at the device. We further find that qubit relaxation in this regime is consistent with a two-photon Orbach process, providing a route for further optimization. Our results demonstrate that FM-EDSR supports ultra-low-power, high-fidelity single-qubit operations, improvements that could benefit scalable hole-spin-based architectures and hybrid spin-photon interfaces.

AI.tldr: 在Ge双量子点中实现flopping-mode空穴自旋量子比特，结合一阶抗电荷噪声保护与高效电驱动，在5 mT近平行磁场、仅-52 dBm驱动功率下取得高保真单比特操作。
AI.motivation: 传统EDSR在有利于相干性和读取的低磁场下需要较大射频驱动功率（Ge平面器件可达-27 dBm），带来加热与串扰问题，不利于可扩展架构。因此需要一种既低功耗又高保真的电驱动方案。
AI.method: 在Ge双量子点中实现flopping-mode (FM) 量子比特，将单自旋离域于双量子点中，兼具对电荷噪声的一阶保护与高效电驱动；通过扫描磁场方向绘制相干性sweet-spot，测量相干时间与单比特门保真度，并分析弛豫机制。
AI.result: 在5 mT近平行磁场、仅-52 dBm驱动功率下，获得T2*=1.4 μs、T2^Hahn=11.5 μs、T2^{φ,CPMG32}=130 μs、T1=226 μs，单比特门保真度最高99.76%（t_{Xπ}=88 ns）。弛豫与双光子Orbach过程一致。
AI.conclusion: FM-EDSR支持超低功耗、高保真单比特操作，可推动可扩展空穴自旋架构与混合自旋-光子接口的发展，并指出通过Orbach机制进一步优化的路径。

title: Pressure-induced electronic and structural evolution of EuIrGe3
summary: We investigated the pressure-induced evolution of the electronic and crystal structure of the noncentrosymmetric BaNiSn3-type antiferromagnet EuIrGe3 using x-ray absorption spectroscopy, synchrotron x-ray diffraction complemented by density functional theory calculations, and electrical resistivity measurements. The Eu L3-edge spectra reveal a continuous increase in the mean Eu valence under compression, accompanied by modifications of the Ge and Ir electronic states. High- pressure x-ray diffraction shows anisotropic lattice compression in the tetragonal (I4mm) phase and provides evidence for a structural phase transition above 38 GPa. The experimentally deter- mined lattice and equation-of-state parameters are in good agreement with the DFT calculations. Electrical resistivity measurements reveal a monotonic increase in the antiferromagnetic ordering temperatures up to 18 GPa, indicating that the antiferromagnetic ground state remains robust despite the increasing contribution of the nonmagnetic Eu3+ configuration to the intermediate va- lence state. These results demonstrate that EuIrGe3 exhibits a pressure response distinct from EuCoGe3 and EuRhGe3, highlighting the important role of the transition metal d-electron states in the pressure-induced electronic and structural evolution of the EuT Ge3 family

AI.tldr: 本研究通过XAS、高压XRD结合DFT与电阻率测量，揭示了非中心对称BaNiSn3型反铁磁体EuIrGe3在压力下的电子与晶体结构演化。
AI.motivation: 研究EuTGe3家族中过渡金属d电子态对压力诱导电子与结构演化的作用，并比较EuIrGe3与EuCoGe3、EuRhGe3的压力响应差异。
AI.method: 采用X射线吸收谱(XAS)、同步辐射X射线衍射(结合DFT计算)及电阻率测量，研究EuIrGe3在压力下电子与晶体结构的变化。
AI.result: Eu L3边谱显示Eu平均价态随压缩持续增加，并伴随Ge、Ir电子态改变；XRD显示四方(I4mm)相各向异性压缩，38 GPa以上发生结构相变；晶格与状态方程参数与DFT吻合；电阻率表明反铁磁有序温度至18 GPa单调升高，反铁磁基态保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: EuIrGe3的压力响应不同于EuCoGe3和EuRhGe3，凸显过渡金属d电子态在EuTGe3家族压力诱导电子与结构演化中的重要作用。

title: Orbital fingerprinting of magnetism across the Mn-Ni-Ga Heusler ternary
summary: In Mn--Ni--Ga Heusler alloys, the competing magnetic states are separated by differences of a few meV per atom, so the ground state has to be resolved from the electronic structure and cannot be read off the composition. Moving away from the stoichiometric compounds, where the established rules for Heusler magnetism fall short, increases this difficulty. To overcome it, we introduce orbital fingerprints taken from the projected density of states, and use them as the input to machine-learning models for classification of the magnetic ordering, for the magnetic moment amplitude, for the spin polarization at the Fermi level and for interpolation of the phase diagram. The models are trained on a dataset of 370 spin-polarized first-principles calculations of quasirandom structures covering the ternary, which show good agreement with the magnetic ground states and lattice parameters available in the literature. For magnetic ordering, the top-ranked descriptor is the same quantity found by first-principles calculations to distinguish the phases, suggesting that the fingerprints capture the underlying physics.

AI.tldr: 该文利用投影态密度提取"轨道指纹"作为机器学习输入，对Mn-Ni-Ga Heusler合金的磁有序、磁矩、自旋极化及相图进行预测。
AI.motivation: Mn-Ni-Ga合金中竞争磁态能量差仅几meV/原子，需从电子结构而非成分确定基态；偏离化学计量比时既有Heusler磁性规则失效，增加了难度。
AI.method: 从投影态密度中提取轨道指纹，用作机器学习模型输入，预测磁有序分类、磁矩大小、费米面自旋极化及相图插值。数据集为370个准随机结构的自旋极化第一性原理计算，覆盖整个三元体系。
AI.result: 模型结果与文献中磁基态和晶格参数吻合良好；磁有序的顶级描述符与第一性原理计算用以区分相的量一致。
AI.conclusion: 轨道指纹能捕捉底层物理，机器学习方法可有效克服Heusler合金磁性预测的困难。

title: Emergent Surface Kondo Flat Band Driven by Competing Interactions in a Topological Ferromagnet
summary: A central goal of modern condensed matter physics is to uncover new quantum states of matter arising from the intertwined effects of strong electron correlations, magnetism, and band topology. Heavy-fermion phases, generated by Kondo interactions, represent one of the most remarkable manifestations of electronic correlations, and topological heavy-fermion states have been identified in several non-magnetic materials. Yet, the consequences of their competition with magnetic order have remained largely unexplored. Here, we reveal a new phenomenon: the spontaneous spatial separation of correlated quantum phases. By showing that magnetism can drive distinct strongly correlated electronic states to coexist in different regions of a single material, our work establishes a previously unknown mechanism for organizing quantum matter and opens a new direction in the study of correlated topological systems. Using \emph{bulk-sensitive} probes, we show that UAsS crystals are, in the bulk, metallic ferromagnets with only moderate correlation-driven band renormalizations. First-principles calculations reveal a topological electronic structure hosting both nodal lines and Weyl points, pointing to a rich underlying topology. Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements are consistent with these predictions, resolving the nodal lines and Weyl crossings. In striking contrast, \emph{surface-sensitive} ARPES and scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy (STM/STS) measurements reveal a pronounced flat band pinned at the Fermi level, accompanied by a sharp resonance -- hallmarks of an emergent, strongly correlated Kondo state not captured by first-principles calculations.

AI.tldr: 该文报道了一种新现象：磁性能驱动关联量子相在单晶不同区域自发空间分离并共存，以UAsS为例展示了体态弱关联的拓扑铁磁与表面强关联近藤态并存。
AI.motivation: 当代凝聚态物理致力于揭示强关联、磁性与能带拓扑交织产生的新量子态。重费米子相是电子关联的典型体现，拓扑重费米子态已在若干非磁材料中被发现，但其与磁序竞争的结果尚不清楚，构成研究空白。
AI.method: 结合体敏感的探测手段、第一性原理计算和角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）探究UAsS晶体；同时使用表面敏感的ARPES与扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/STS）探测表面电子态。
AI.result: 体态测量表明UAsS是金属铁磁体，仅有中等强度的关联驱动能带重整化；计算揭示其具有包含节点线与Weyl点的拓扑电子结构，ARPES结果与之吻合，分辨出节点线和Weyl交叉。相比之下，表面敏感测量揭示出钉扎在费米能级处的显著平带及尖锐共振，这是第一性原理计算无法捕捉的、强关联近藤态的标志。
AI.conclusion: 磁性可驱动不同的强关联电子态在同一材料的不同区域共存，建立了组织量子物质的全新机制，为关联拓扑体系研究开辟了新方向。

title: Machine Learning for High-Entropy Catalysts: Methods and Applications
summary: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit exceptional catalytic performance in various reactions due to their high configurational entropy, synergistic elemental effects, tunable electronic structures, and excellent structural stability. However, the vast compositional space of HEA catalysts makes traditional experimental and theoretical design costly and inefficient. In recent years, data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have emerged as powerful tools for studying HEAs in catalysis. Through predictive models and ML surrogates, researchers can decipher the intricate composition-structure-performance relationships of these materials. In addition, by leveraging large language models (LLMs) for knowledge extraction, hypothesis generation and validation, and as a foundation to build integrated design workflows, ML approaches can significantly accelerate the design of novel HEA catalysts. This review systematically summarizes the latest methodological advances and applications of ML methods for HEAs in catalysis, discusses the challenges, and offers insights into future research directions to support the rational design and efficient development of catalysts.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统总结了机器学习方法在高熵合金催化中的应用与最新方法学进展，并讨论挑战与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 高熵合金催化性能优异，但其庞大组分空间使传统实验与理论设计成本高、效率低，亟需数据驱动方法加速设计。
AI.method: 通过综述形式梳理机器学习方法：利用预测模型与ML代理模型解析组分-结构-性能关系，并结合大语言模型进行知识提取、假设生成与验证，构建集成设计流程。
AI.result: 总结了ML在高熵合金催化中的最新方法学进展与应用，展示其在揭示复杂构效关系及加速新催化剂设计方面的能力。
AI.conclusion: ML与LLM有望显著加速新型高熵合金催化剂的设计；综述指出当前挑战并展望未来研究方向以支持理性设计与高效开发。

title: Non-Thermal Effects in Fermionic Atoms Coupled to Open Cavities
summary: We study a Fermi-Hubbard model coupled to a open dissipative single cavity mode. Using Keldysh diagrammatics we derive and solve the quantum kinetic equations for the fermions, taking the bosonic cavity mode as a source of non-equilibrium noise and dissipation. In absence of Hubbard interactions we show that the fermions reach generically a non-equilibrium steady-state, characterized by a non-thermal distribution function. Quite interestingly we demonstrate that the latter exactly nullifies the heat-current between fermions and cavity mode. We discuss the regimes of parameters where a low-frequency effective temperature description emerges and how the fluctuations affect the mean-field phase diagram for the superradiance phase transition. Finally we include Hubbard interaction in the weak-coupling regime and show that it leads to a crossover towards a full equilibrium distribution.

AI.tldr: 研究Fermi-Hubbard模型与耗散单腔模耦合，用Keldysh图方法推导并求解费米子量子动理学方程，发现无相互作用时费米子达到非热稳态且热流被抵消，并讨论有效温度、超辐射相变及Hubbard相互作用的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究开放量子腔中费米子与耗散腔模耦合的非平衡行为，理解非热稳态、热流、有效温度及相互作用如何影响超辐射相变。
AI.method: 采用Keldysh图技术推导并求解费米子的量子动理学方程，将玻色腔模视为非平衡噪声和耗散源；先分析无Hubbard相互作用情形，再纳入弱耦合Hubbard相互作用。
AI.result: 无Hubbard相互作用时，费米子达到非平衡稳态并呈现非热分布函数，该分布恰好抵消费米子与腔模间的热流；确定了低频有效温度描述的参数区间，并分析涨落对超辐射相变平均场相图的影响。
AI.conclusion: 弱耦合Hubbard相互作用导致系统向完全平衡分布过渡。

title: Collective Charge-\(2e\) Bosonic Excitations in Charge-Ordered Systems
summary: Charge order is conventionally characterized by a static modulation of the electronic density, while its collective excitations remain less developed from a quasiparticle perspective than those of spin-ordered systems. Here, we formulate the collective excititations of charge order within an effective charge-pseudospin model, in which the charge-ordered ground state is represented by staggered pseudospin order. Quantizing fluctuations around this ordered state via a Holstein--Primakoff transformation, we reveal two branches of bosonic quasiparticles with degenerate, gapped dispersions that carry opposite quantized electric charges $\pm 2e$. We therefore term these charge-$2e$ bosons ``\textit{bichargons},'' closely paralleling the two magnon branches of a bipartite antiferromagnet that carry opposite spin angular momenta. We show that a temperature gradient drives the diffusion of thermally excited bichargons, generating a charge Seebeck response when the degeneracy between the oppositely charged branches is lifted by tuning the chemical potential away from the charge-neutrality point. In contrast, despite carrying finite electric charges, a thermal bichargon gas remains electrically insulating under a static electric field because bichargon quasiparticle number is not conserved. An ac electric field, however, can parametrically generate coherent pairs of oppositely charged bichargons that support a finite dc drift current in the presence of a bias electric field, offering a bosonic analogue of photoconductivity mediated by photoexcited electron--hole pairs in semiconductors. Our results establish bichargons as a new class of collective bosonic charge carriers in charge-ordered systems and extend the quasiparticle paradigm of magnons in spin-ordered systems to the charge sector, with electric charge replacing spin angular momentum as the transported quantity.

AI.tldr: 该文在有效电荷-赝自旋模型中构建电荷序的集体激发，通过Holstein-Primakoff量子化发现两支带相反电荷±2e的玻色准粒子"bichargon"，并预言其驱动Seebeck响应及类光电导行为。
AI.motivation: 自旋有序系统的集体激发（磁振子）已有成熟的准粒子理论，而电荷序的集体激发从准粒子视角仍发展不足，作者希望将磁振子范式推广到电荷领域。
AI.method: 构建有效电荷-赝自旋模型，将电荷序基态表示为交错赝自旋序，围绕有序态用Holstein-Primakoff变换量子化涨落。
AI.result: 得到两支简并、有能隙的玻色准粒子（bichargon），携带相反量子化电荷±2e；温度梯度驱动其扩散产生电荷Seebeck响应（需化学势偏离电荷中性点破简并）；静态电场下为绝缘（准粒子数不守恒）；交流电场可参数化产生相干对并在偏置电场下形成直流漂移电流。
AI.conclusion: bichargon被确立为电荷序系统中一类新的集体玻色电荷载流子，将自旋有序系统的磁振子准粒子范式扩展到电荷领域，以电荷替代自旋角动量作为输运量。

title: Ultralow-Tensile Strain Enables Exciton Funneling and Energy Transfer to Boost MoSe2 Photoluminescence Quantum Yield
summary: Strain engineering is a powerful route for controlling the exciton dynamics in van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures (HSs). The interlayer energy transfer (ET) process is another key factor in controlling the photocarrier relaxation pathways in vdW HSs. In this work, we combine these two processes to achieve an 8-fold enhancement to the relative photoluminescence (PL) quantum yield (QY) in a HS formed from monolayers of ReS2 and MoSe2, separated by a thin hBN interlayer, placed onto an hBN bubble. We achieve this enhancement by applying only 0.1% biaxial tensile strain, which results in efficient exciton funneling and an increased transition dipole moment. Our experimental data are supported by first-principles density-functional theory and coherent transfer-matrix method calculations, ruling out optical interference as the dominant origin of the enhancement. This work provides an innovative route for enhancing the PL QY of vdW materials via interplay between the tensile strain and the ET process.

AI.tldr: 通过0.1%双轴拉伸应变，结合层间能量转移过程，实现了ReS2/MoSe2范德华异质结8倍的光致发光量子产率增强。
AI.motivation: 应变工程可调控范德华异质结中的激子动力学，层间能量转移(ET)也是控制光载流子弛豫路径的关键因素，但如何将两者结合以增强发光量子产率尚待探索。
AI.method: 构建由单层ReS2与MoSe2、中间夹薄hBN层、置于hBN气泡上的异质结，施加0.1%双轴拉伸应变；结合第一性原理密度泛函理论(DFT)与相干转移矩阵法计算进行验证。
AI.result: 仅施加0.1%双轴拉伸应变即获得8倍相对PL量子产率增强，源于高效激子漏斗效应和跃迁偶极矩增大；计算排除了光学干涉作为增强主因的可能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明拉伸应变与能量转移过程的相互作用是增强范德华材料PL量子产率的创新途径。

title: Modeling Dynamic Magnetic Response of Spinel Soft Ferrites with the Steepest-Entropy-Ascent Quantum Thermodynamics Formalism
summary: Selecting soft ferrites for alternating-field applications requires balancing magnetic response, dissipation, nonlinearity, and heating. We use a field-driven steepest-entropy-ascent quantum thermodynamic (SEAQT) model to compare the electron, phonon, and magnon responses of Fe$_3$O$_4$, MnFe$2$O$4$, and (Mn${0.5}$Zn${0.5}$)Fe$_2$O$_4$ within a common first-principles framework. The model treats spatially uniform longitudinal relaxation and neglects domain-wall motion, transverse rotation, resonance, eddy-current effects, and heat removal. We use $τ_e=0.05$ ps and $τ_p=3$ ps for all three materials, with effective longitudinal magnon relaxation times of 500, 200, and 85 ps, respectively; these literature-motivated values are model inputs, not fits to measured losses. Within this framework, the Mn--Zn ferrite gives the largest peak longitudinal magnetization change, retains its response best at high frequency, and shows the largest work per cycle and peak-to-peak magnon temperature change, whereas MnFe$_2$O$_4$ gives the largest normalized $χ''$ peak. Thus, no single ferrite ranks highest across all metrics: the preferred material depends on the property, frequency, field amplitude, and cation configuration of interest. The model therefore provides a spectrum- and kinetics-resolved screening tool for engineering comparison of ferrites rather than a prediction of total core loss.

AI.tldr: 本文用SEAOT量子热力学模型统一比较Fe3O4、MnFe2O4和(Mn0.5Zn0.5)Fe2O4的电子、声子、磁振子响应，发现没有单一铁氧体在所有指标上领先，材料优选取决于具体性能、频率、场幅和阳离子构型。
AI.motivation: 选择用于交变场应用的软磁铁氧体需在磁响应、损耗、非线性和发热之间权衡，但缺乏在同一框架下对多种铁氧体进行谱与动力学分辨比较的工具。
AI.method: 采用场驱动的陡峭熵升量子热力学（SEAOT）模型，假设空间均匀纵向弛豫，忽略畴壁运动、横向转动、共振、涡流和散热；三种材料统一使用τe=0.05 ps、τp=3 ps，纵向磁振子弛豫时间分别取500、200、85 ps（文献值作为输入而非拟合）。
AI.result: Mn-Zn铁氧体具有最大的峰值纵向磁化变化、高频响应保持最好、每周期功和峰峰磁振子温度变化最大；MnFe2O4则给出最大的归一化χ''峰值。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一铁氧体在所有指标上排名最高，优选材料取决于所关注的性能、频率、场幅和阳离子构型；该模型可作为谱与动力学分辨的筛选工具，用于铁氧体的工程比较，而非总磁芯损耗的预测。

title: Unconstrained compact lattice QED$_{2+1}$ coupled to phonons: Gauss sectors, orthogonal semimetal, and deconfined criticality
summary: Gauge theoretic descriptions of 2D quantum magnets are defined on a restricted physical Hilbert space by imposing Gauss's law. In this work, we study an unconstrained compact lattice QED$_{2+1}$ coupled to bond phonons, in which local Gauss operators are conserved, but their eigenvalues are not a priori fixed. Using exact auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations at $N_f = 2$, we investigate how the physical Gauss sector becomes energetically favourable, and how this process is connected to confinement and symmetry breaking. We identify an orthogonal semimetallic (OSM) phase, in which fermions striped off their gauge charge and form a Dirac liquid. This phase mixes various Gauss sectors, and becomes unstable when Gauss's law is explicitly enforced. Upon the imposition of Gauss's law, compactness allows for monopole excitations carrying antiferromagnetic (AFM) and valence-bond-solid (VBS) quantum numbers. Gauge field fluctuations and spinon-phonon coupling tune between the competition of such monopoles and generate a phase diagram with OSM, AFM and VBS orders. The transitions out of the OSM phase coincide with the dynamical generation of Gauss's law, while the competition between AFM and VBS charged monopoles produces a transition consistent with deconfined quantum criticality. Thus our results establish that upon the projection to the physical Hilbert space, deconfinement in compact lattice QED$_{2+1}$ is always unstable towards either AFM or VBS order.

AI.tldr: 本文用无约束格点QED₃耦合键声子并做辅助场量子蒙特卡洛，研究了物理高斯扇区的能量选择、禁闭与对称破缺之间的关系，发现投影到物理希尔伯特空间后禁闭相总是不稳定，趋向AFM或VBS序。
AI.motivation: 规范理论描述二维量子磁体时通常在受限物理希尔伯特空间上定义，并通过施加高斯定律约束实现；但高斯扇区如何被能量选择、以及这与禁闭和对称破缺的联系尚不清楚。作者希望用可控的数值方法研究无约束情形如何过渡到物理约束情形。
AI.method: 研究无约束紧致格点QED₂₊₁耦合键声子，其中局域高斯算符守恒但本征值不预先固定。采用N_f=2的精确辅助场量子蒙特卡洛模拟，分析物理高斯扇区的能量有利性及其与禁闭和对称破缺的关系。
AI.result: 识别出一个正交半金属（OSM）相，其中费米子剥离规范荷形成狄拉克液体。该相混合不同高斯扇区，并在显式施加高斯定律时变得不稳定。施加高斯定律后，紧致性允许携带反铁磁（AFM）和价键固体（VBS）量子数的磁单极激发；规范场涨落和自旋子-声子耦合调控这些磁单极竞争，生成包含OSM、AFM和VBS的相图。离开OSM相的转变伴随高斯定律的动力学生成，而AFM与VBS带电磁单极之间的竞争产生与去禁闭量子临界一致的转变。
AI.conclusion: 投影到物理希尔伯特空间后，紧致格点QED₂₊₁中的去禁闭总是不稳定，会趋向反铁磁或价键固体序。

title: Coherent antiferromagnetic resonance in MnO driven by impulsive terahertz excitation
summary: Antiferromagnets (AFMs) offer a promising platform for ultrafast information processing owing to their intrinsically fast spin dynamics and vanishing net magnetization. Realizing this potential, however, requires understanding how terahertz fields excite coherent magnons and how the resulting spin motion is transduced into an optical signal. Here we report impulsive terahertz (THz) excitation and time-domain detection of the antiferromagnetic resonance (AFMR) in single-crystal manganese(II) oxide. Time-resolved birefringence measurements reveal long-lived coherent spin oscillations in the AFM phase. The resonance softens and becomes strongly damped upon warming toward the Néel temperature. Despite this similar excitation behavior, the detected birefringence in MnO is markedly weaker than in NiO. We associate this suppressed optical visibility with the weak spin--orbit-mediated magneto-optical coupling of orbital-singlet, high-spin Mn$^{2+}$. These results demonstrate that coherent magnon excitation and its optical detection are governed by distinct microscopic interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在一氧化锰(MnO)单晶中利用脉冲太赫兹场激发并时域探测反铁磁共振(AFMR)，发现长寿命相干自旋振荡，共振在接近奈尔温度时软化并强阻尼，但双折射信号远弱于NiO，归因于Mn²⁺弱的自旋-轨道介导磁光耦合。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体因超快自旋动力学和无净磁化而有望用于超快信息处理，但需理解太赫兹场如何激发相干磁振子以及自旋运动如何转化为光学信号。
AI.method: 对MnO单晶施加脉冲太赫兹激发，采用时间分辨双折射测量进行时域探测，研究AFMR随温度接近奈尔温度的变化，并与NiO对比。
AI.result: 观测到AFM相中长寿命相干自旋振荡；共振随升温接近奈尔温度而软化并强烈阻尼；尽管激发行为相似，MnO的双折射信号明显弱于NiO。
AI.conclusion: MnO中抑制的光学可见性源于轨道单态高自旋Mn²⁺的自旋-轨道介导磁光耦合较弱，表明相干磁振子激发与其光学探测由不同的微观相互作用支配。

title: Multiconfigurational Analysis of Local Electronic Structure of $\mathrm{RuO_2}$ Using Relativistic Embedded Clusters
summary: We present a multiconfigurational, relativistic embedded-cluster study of the local electronic structure of ruthenium dioxide ($\mathrm{RuO_2}$), a candidate altermagnetic material. Starting from free $\mathrm{Ru}$ ions, we progressively build up the local environment through a $\mathrm{Ru+Q_6}$ electrostatic model, a bare $\mathrm{[RuO_6]^{8-}}$ ligand model, and finally a high-accuracy $\mathrm{RuO_6}$@CTEP embedded cluster that reproduces the crystalline surroundings. All systems are treated at the SA-CASSCF and NEVPT2+SOC levels of theory to capture strong electron correlation and spin-orbit coupling on an equal footing. While the formal local site symmetry of the $\mathrm{Ru}$ sites in $\mathrm{RuO_2}$ is orthorhombic ($D_{2h}$), we find that the calculated $4d$-orbital energy spectrum and its splitting pattern behave much closer to the higher tetragonal ($D_{4h}$) symmetry, preserving a strong quasi-degeneracy among the relevant $4d$ orbitals. Since the local $xy$ quadrupolar order responsible for altermagnetic spin splitting in independent-particle models relies on this symmetry reduction, its suppression by orbital quasi-degeneracy offers a natural explanation for why altermagnetism is not observed in bulk $\mathrm{RuO_2}$ experiments, in contrast to the robust altermagnetic signatures reported in strained thin films.

AI.tldr: 本文用多组态相对论嵌入簇方法研究RuO₂局域电子结构，发现Ru的4d轨道近乎简并，呈现D₄h对称特征而非形式上的D₂h，从而抑制了交错磁所需的xy四极序。
AI.motivation: RuO₂是候选交错磁（altermagnetic）材料，但块体实验未观测到交错磁信号，而应变薄膜却有稳健信号，其根源尚不清楚。本文旨在从局域电子结构与对称性角度解释这一矛盾。
AI.method: 构建递进式嵌入簇模型：自由Ru离子→Ru+Q₆静电模型→裸[RuO₆]^{8-}配体模型→高精度RuO₆@CTEP嵌入簇（再现晶体环境）。全部体系采用SA-CASSCF与NEVPT2+SOC方法，同时处理强电子相关与自旋轨道耦合。
AI.result: 虽然Ru位点形式对称性为D₂h，但计算的4d轨道能谱及其劈裂模式更接近更高的D₄h对称性，关键4d轨道间保持强的准简并。
AI.conclusion: 局域xy四极序依赖对称性降低，而轨道准简并抑制了该序，为块体RuO₂中未观测到交错磁、而应变薄膜却出现稳健交错磁信号提供了自然解释。

title: Divergent Solid-state Conversion Pathways in Evaporated All-perovskite Tandem Solar Cells
comment: 54 pages (main text: 20 pages, 5 figures; Supplementary Information: 34 pages, 30 figures, 2 tables)
summary: Sequential thermal evaporation (sTE) is emerging as a solvent-free route to high-quality mid-bandgap perovskites, but its extension to mixed-halide wide-bandgap (WBG) and Sn-Pb narrow-bandgap (NBG) absorbers for all-perovskite tandem solar cells (TSCs) remains limited by an incomplete understanding of solid-state conversion. Here, using time-sliced ex situ analysis, we reveal divergent solid-state conversion mechanisms in sequentially evaporated WBG and NBG precursor stacks. In WBG stacks, formamidinium (FA)-containing species penetrate the inorganic template and Br/I redistribution precedes substantial three-dimensional perovskite formation. The photoactive phase then crystallizes from a chemically mixed reservoir, and absolute PbBr$_2$ thickness, rather than nominal PbBr$_2$/PbI$_2$ ratio, determines the final bandgap. In NBG stacks, by contrast, an early Pb-rich perovskite phase forms upon formamidinium iodide deposition, restricting further FA penetration into the buried SnI$_2$ precursor. Subsequent annealing promotes rapid lattice reorganization faster than Sn/Pb interdiffusion, leaving vertical compositional gradients. Guided by these insights, we develop sTE absorbers with bandgaps spanning 1.26-1.96 eV and demonstrate the first evaporated all-perovskite TSC, reaching a power conversion efficiency of 19.2%. Encapsulated tandems retain on average 80% of their initial efficiency after 1,200 h at 65 $^\circ$C (ISOS-D-2). These results establish bandgap-specific control of solid-state conversion as a design principle for sequentially evaporated perovskite tandem photovoltaics.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了顺序热蒸发(sTE)中宽带隙(WBG)与窄带隙(NBG)前驱体叠层具有不同的固态转化机制，据此开发出带隙1.26-1.96 eV的吸收层，并首次实现蒸发型全钙钛矿叠层电池，效率达19.2%。
AI.motivation: 顺序热蒸发是无溶剂制备中带隙钙钛矿的路线，但扩展到混合卤化物WBG和Sn-Pb NBG吸收层用于全钙钛矿叠层电池时，受限于对固态转化机制的理解不足。
AI.method: 采用时间切片离位分析，对比研究顺序蒸发WBG与NBG前驱体叠层的固态转化过程。
AI.result: WBG中FA物种穿透无机模板，Br/I重分布先于三维钙钛矿形成，最终带隙由绝对PbBr2厚度决定；NBG中FAI沉积后形成富Pb钙钛矿相，限制FA渗透，退火导致快速晶格重组并留下垂直组分梯度。据此制备带隙1.26-1.96 eV吸收层，首次实现蒸发型全钙钛矿叠层电池效率19.2%，封装器件在65°C、1200 h后保持80%效率(ISOS-D-2)。
AI.conclusion: 确立了带隙特异性固态转化控制作为顺序蒸发钙钛矿叠层光伏的设计原则。

title: Lyapunov-controlled thermalization: an exact real-time example
summary: A verified Kubo-Martin-Schwinger (KMS) relation, after a drive has ceased, is not sufficient evidence to prove equilibrium. We demonstrate this in a large-$N$ large-$q$ Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) quench protocol. Although all post-quench fermion correlators are exactly thermal, a second quench back to the initial Hamiltonian reveals hidden memory of the initial state. It is encoded in correlators connecting to times before the first quench. This memory is an extensive nonequilibrium (NEQ) witness with its decay rate being the Lyapunov exponent $λ_L$. Thus $λ_L$ sets the rate at which the state becomes effectively indistinguishable from a Gibbs state. Despite being a unitary interacting many-body system, the complete NEQ real-time evolution is obtained exactly in the large-$N$, large-$q$ limit, making the setup ideal for analytically studying thermalization.

AI.tldr: 验证的KMS关系不足以证明系统达到平衡。在大N大q SYK淬火协议中，虽所有淬火后费米子关联函数完全热化，但二次淬火回初始哈密顿量揭示隐藏的初态记忆，其衰减率为Lyapunov指数。
AI.motivation: 检验"满足KMS关系即达到平衡"这一常见假设是否成立，探究热化与平衡的真正判据。
AI.method: 采用大N、大q极限下的SYK淬火协议：先对系统进行淬火，待其关联函数热化后再进行第二次淬火回到初始哈密顿量，测量连接第一次淬火前时间的关联函数。
AI.result: 所有淬火后费米子关联函数精确呈热态，但二次淬火揭示初态记忆；该记忆为广延的非平衡见证量，其衰减率为Lyapunov指数λ_L。
AI.conclusion: KMS关系满足并非平衡的充分证据；λ_L决定量子态变为有效Gibbs态的速率，该可解多体系统为研究热化提供理想平台。

title: A Computational Method to Simulate Electrostatic Actuation in Polycatenated Architected Materials
summary: A novel class of polycatenated architected materials (PAMs) has recently emerged, exhibiting distinctive mechanical properties such as stress-strain hysteresis and a geometry-driven transition between solid-like and fluid-like behavior. Although finite element models exist for conventional PAMs, none currently account for electrostatic effects. Here, we propose and qualitatively validate a computational framework to simulate the structure, dynamics, and mechanical response of electrostatically charged PAMs. Our approach successfully reproduces electrostatic actuation in close agreement with experiments, and reveals that electrostatic charges enable a reversible fluid-to-solid transition while also providing a means to estimate electrostatic stiffness. Notably, stiffness enhancements of up to sevenfold are achieved upon charging. This work expands the design space of PAMs and offers a predictive tool for actively controllable mechanical metamaterials.

AI.tldr: 提出了静电带电多链编织结构材料(PAMs)的计算模拟框架，可复现实验中的静电驱动，揭示可逆的流-固转变，并实现高达7倍的刚度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有PAMs有限元模型未考虑静电效应，而PAMs已展现应力-应变滞后及几何驱动的固-液转变等独特性能，亟需纳入静电作用的模拟手段。
AI.method: 提出并定性验证一个计算框架，用于模拟静电带电PAMs的结构、动力学与力学响应。
AI.result: 成功复现实验中的静电驱动；发现静电荷可实现可逆的流-固转变，并提供估算静电刚度的方法；带电后刚度提升最高达7倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了PAMs的设计空间，为主动可控力学超材料提供了预测工具。

title: Engineering Weak Universality with Quantum Dots
summary: Quantum critical theories with continuously varying critical exponents remain challenging to access experimentally. Here, we propose quantum-dot architectures for realizing the quantum Ashkin-Teller and XYZ/eight-vertex models using resonator-mediated and direct Coulomb interactions, respectively. We focus on the Ashkin-Teller and eight-vertex critical lines, which are connected by a non-local duality relating local order parameters to topological string operators. The resulting platforms provide microscopic control over the parameters explicitly controlling critical exponents, with the Coulomb-based implementation enabling stronger interaction regimes. We demonstrate that continuously varying critical behavior can already be resolved in short chains. For experimentally realistic parameters, the accessible interaction range is expected to produce changes in the critical exponents of order $10\%$ for the Ashkin-Teller model and substantially larger changes for the eight-vertex model. In both cases, the predicted variations lie well above the estimated measurement uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 提出量子点架构实现量子Ashkin-Teller与XYZ/八顶点模型，可在短链中分辨连续变化的临界指数。
AI.motivation: 具有连续变化临界指数的量子临界理论难以实验探测，本文旨在提供可行的实验实现方案。
AI.method: 分别利用谐振腔介导相互作用和直接库仑相互作用构建量子点架构，实现量子Ashkin-Teller模型与XYZ/八顶点模型；聚焦由非局域对偶（联系局域序参量与拓扑弦算符）连接的两条临界线，实现对控制临界指数参数的微观调控。
AI.result: 库仑实现可达更强相互作用区；短链即可分辨连续变化的临界行为；实验现实参数下，Ashkin-Teller模型临界指数预计变化约10%，八顶点模型变化更大，均远高于测量不确定度。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为实验观测连续变化临界指数提供可行途径，且预期信号可被现有实验分辨。

title: Spacetime Dynamics of Altermagnetic Magnons
summary: Distinguishing altermagnetism from conventional ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism typically relies on momentum-space probes. Here, we show that the real-space spreading of a localized spin excitation provides a distinctive dynamical fingerprint of altermagnetic order. Using linear spin-wave theory on a two-dimensional checkerboard lattice with nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor couplings J_1 and J_2, we demonstrate that finite J_2 produces direction-dependent magnon group velocities and splits the two magnon branches. The resulting propagation remains closer to that of an antiferromagnet than a ferromagnet, retaining an approximately circular outer wavefront, while the direction-dependent magnon velocities produce a pronounced cross-like spatial structure inside this front. We further show that changing the sign of J_2 to enter the unfrustrated regime (J_2<0) increases the characteristic propagation velocities and interchanges the diagonal directions of enhanced propagation, corresponding to a pi/2 rotation of the anisotropic spatial pattern. These results establish spacetime dynamics as a complementary probe of altermagnetic magnons, providing a route to identifying unconventional magnetic order through real-space propagation patterns in solid-state and synthetic quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用局域自旋激发的实空间传播动力学来区分交错磁性与传统铁磁、反铁磁，发现交叉状空间结构是交错磁序的独特指纹。
AI.motivation: 传统区分交错磁（altermagnetism）与铁磁/反铁磁的方法依赖动量空间探测手段，需要寻找互补的、基于实空间动力学的判别方式。
AI.method: 在二维棋盘格（checkerboard）晶格上，用线性自旋波理论处理最近邻耦合 J_1 和次近邻耦合 J_2，分析局域自旋激发的时空传播，并研究 J_2 符号变化（进入非阻挫区 J_2<0）的影响。
AI.result: 有限 J_2 产生方向依赖的磁振子群速度并劈裂两个磁振子分支；传播整体更接近反铁磁（保持近圆形外波前），但在波前内部形成明显的十字状空间结构。J_2 变号后传播速度增大，且对角增强方向互换，对应各向异性图案旋转 π/2。
AI.conclusion: 时空动力学可作为交错磁磁振子的互补探针，通过实空间传播图案识别非常规磁序，适用于固态及合成量子系统。

title: Tuning the Coercive Field in Ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2-Al2O3 Heterostructures via Interfacial Charge Dynamics
comment: 35 manuscript pages, 7 figures, 12 supplemental pages, 17 supplemental figures
