summary: Interleaving dielectric layers into ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) films increases the memory window (MW) beyond what is accounted for by the dielectric constants. Determining the physical mechanisms behind these MW improvements is critical to reaching the full potential of HZO FeNAND. Here, we show that MW improvements stem from the interfacial charge dynamics enabled by oxygen vacancies at the interlayer interface. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy(XPS) etching experiments demonstrate increased off-stoichiometry at the interface, with a 2.3x increase in oxygen vacancies. Polarization-dependent XPS and first-order reversal curves(FORC) show that tunneling between interfacial defect states causes a bidirectional internal bias of 0.56MV/cm. The impact of defects is further corroborated through phase-field modeling(PFM), which only recreates the coercive fields, FORC, and internal bias for defect densities and tunneling barrier heights that are consistent with experiment, quantitatively capturing an internal electric field of 0.55 MV/cm. The phase field models are then used to simulate 36 devices with varied charge densities and dielectric thickness to provide a predictive framework for further improvements in the MW of interlayer HZO. These findings redefine the role of defects in ferroelectric HZO from deleterious to engineerable and provide critical insights into how to tune ferroelectric device architectures for improved memory.

AI.tldr: 在HZO铁电薄膜中插入介电层可提升存储窗口(MW)，本文揭示其机制源于界面氧空位介导的界面电荷动力学。
AI.motivation: 介电层插层能提升HZO的MW，但其增益超出介电常数所能解释的范围，需明确其物理机制以充分发挥HZO FeNAND潜力。
AI.method: 结合XPS刻蚀实验、极化依赖XPS与一阶翻转曲线(FORC)，并采用相场建模(PFM)进行对照与预测模拟(36个器件)。
AI.result: 界面处氧空位增加2.3倍；界面缺陷态间隧穿引起0.56 MV/cm双向内建偏压；PFM仅在缺陷密度与隧穿势垒高度匹配实验时才能重现矫顽场、FORC和内建偏压，定量给出0.55 MV/cm内建电场。
AI.conclusion: 缺陷在铁电HZO中的作用由"有害"转变为"可工程化"，为优化铁电器件架构与提升存储器性能提供设计框架。

title: Statistics, 't Hooft Anomaly, and the Else-Nayak Index: a careful comparison of concepts
summary: Generalized symmetries and topological excitations, as well as symmetry anomalies and the statistics of topological excitations, are widely believed to be related. There are, however, pitfalls in how this relation is established. A lattice truncation of a symmetry transformation to a finite patch gives a symmetry patch operator that creates symmetry defects at its boundary. This geometric picture resembles a hopping operator creating topological excitations at the boundary of its support, but does not provide well-defined statistics, let alone guarantee agreement with the symmetry anomaly. A more natural and robust relation is that the hopping operators of topological excitations are symmetric: they commute with symmetry transformations. Under suitable assumptions, this condition yields a one-to-one correspondence between statistics and anomalies. We further couple boundary matter to a DW gauge field in one higher dimension to explain this relation from the perspective of gauging. A hopping operator is, in essence, a gauge-invariant operator acting on the physical degrees of freedom after gauging. Once the gauge-field background is fixed, global symmetry comes from gauge transformations that preserve that background, while the symmetric condition on hopping is precisely the remaining gauge invariance. This distinction clarifies potential misconceptions in the literature and provides a more reliable framework for comparing symmetries and topological excitations.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了广义对称、拓扑激发统计与其对称反常之间关系的确立方式，提出"跳跃算符是对称的"这一自然且稳健的判据，并在适当假设下给出统计与反常的一一对应。
AI.motivation: 文献中普遍认为广义对称、拓扑激发、对称反常与统计彼此相关，但既有建立方式存在陷阱：将对称变换截断到有限区域得到的"对称补丁算符"只是几何图像，既不能给出良定义的统计，也不保证与对称反常一致，导致文献中的误解。
AI.method: 提出以拓扑激发的跃迁算符与对称变换对易（"跃迁算符是对称的"）作为核心条件；进一步在一维更高维中把边界物质与DW规范场耦合，从gauging视角解释：跃迁算符本质是gauging后作用在物理自由度上的规范不变算符，固定规范场背景后，整体对称来自保持该背景的规范变换，而跃迁的对称条件恰是剩余的规范不变性。
AI.result: 在适当假设下，该条件给出统计与反常之间的一一对应；gauging视角清晰区分了不同概念，厘清了文献中的潜在误解。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了比较对称性与拓扑激发的更可靠框架，纠正了将对称补丁算符等同于统计判据的常见误区。

title: Strain-Induced Metal-to-Insulator Transition in Antiferromagnetic SrCrO$_3$ Thin Films
comment: 10 Pages, 4 figures, Supplement Information with additional 5 pages, 7 figures
summary: Antiferromagnetic (AF) metals are rare, yet they combine properties attractive for spintronic devices like robustness against stray fields and electrical readout. Among AF metal oxide candidates, SrCrO$_3$ remains largely unexplored due to its notoriously difficult synthesis. In this paper, we demonstrate the growth of high-quality SrCrO$_3$ thin films by magnetron sputtering on substrates that impose a wide range of tensile and compressive strains. Muon spin relaxation experiments, supported by x-ray magnetic dichroism, unveil the emergence of an AF phase with dilute magnetic disorder at low temperatures, while resistivity measurements confirm the simultaneous metallic ground state of SrCrO$_3$ under low strain. As both compressive and tensile strain increase, a metal-to-insulator transition is induced in the films, while the onset of the magnetic transition temperature remains unchanged. Moreover, an intriguing resistivity upturn, accompanied by a change in the dominant charge-carrier type, occurs at a temperature that correlates with strain. These observations suggest a complex strain-dependent band structure, with strain-induced Jahn-Teller distortions or tilting of the CrO$_6$ octahedra that emerge depending on the sign of the strain, as inferred from density functional theory calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁控溅射在不同应变衬底上生长高质量SrCrO₃薄膜，结合μSR、XMCD、输运测量和DFT，揭示其低应变下兼具金属性与反铁磁（含稀磁无序）基态，应变增大诱导金属-绝缘体转变，并伴随与应变相关的电阻上翘和载流子类型变化。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁金属稀少但具备抗杂散场、可电学读出等自旋电子学优势；SrCrO₃是潜在反铁磁金属氧化物，但因合成困难而研究不足。
AI.method: 采用磁控溅射在施加宽范围拉伸与压缩应变的衬底上生长SrCrO₃薄膜；用μ子自旋弛豫（μSR）与X射线磁二色性（XMCD）探测磁性；用电阻率测量研究输运；用DFT计算推断能带与结构畸变。
AI.result: 低应变下SrCrO₃呈金属基态并出现低温反铁磁相（含稀磁无序）；压缩与拉伸应变均增大时发生金属-绝缘体转变，但磁转变温度起始点不变；出现与应变相关的电阻上翘及主导载流子类型改变。
AI.conclusion: SrCrO₃具有复杂的应变依赖能带结构，应变可通过诱导Jahn-Teller畸变或CrO₆八面体倾斜（取决于应变符号）调控其电磁性质。

title: Magnon-Phonon Dynamics in Multidimensional Antiferromagnetic Oxides
summary: Antiferromagnetic oxides offer a compelling paradigm for magnonics. Combining ab initio and spin Hamiltonian modeling, we map Cr2O3 from bulk to monolayer limits, verifying stability via phonon spectra. Contrary to previously predicted half-metallic ferromagnetic monolayer phases, we conclusively demonstrate that monolayer and bilayer configurations preserve an antiferromagnetic semiconductor ground state despite systematic gap narrowing. Intersecting magnon and phonon branches drive strong hybridization, establishing low-dimensional Cr2O3 as an ideal platform for quantum spintronics.

AI.tldr: 通过从头算与自旋哈密顿量建模，系统研究Cr2O3从体相到单层的磁性与稳定性，发现单/双层仍保持反铁磁半导体基态，且磁振子-声子强杂化为量子自旋电子学提供平台。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁氧化物是磁子学的理想体系，但低维Cr2O3的基态磁性存在争议，此前被预测为半金属铁磁相，需要澄清其真实基态与稳定性。
AI.method: 结合从头算（ab initio）与自旋哈密顿量建模，对Cr2O3从体相到单层进行系统映射，并通过声子谱验证结构稳定性。
AI.result: 与以往预测的半金属铁磁单层相不同，单层与双层Cr2O3均保持反铁磁半导体基态，仅出现系统性带隙收窄；磁振子与声子分支相交导致强杂化。
AI.conclusion: 低维Cr2O3是量子自旋电子学的理想平台，其反铁磁半导体基态与磁振子-声子杂化特性具有重要应用前景。

title: Spin-Lattice Dynamics and Interactions in Magnonic Spinels
summary: Minimizing magnetic damping while understanding spin-lattice interactions remains a key challenge for magnonics. We show site-specific Al/Li ordering in spinel ferrites drives a ferrimagnetic insulating state, quenching the Fermi-level density of states. \textit{Ab initio} calculations reveal collective acoustic modes alongside sub-lattice-selective optical modes on tetrahedral and octahedral networks, providing a microscopic understanding of substitution-driven spin dynamics. Crucially, the low-frequency magnon and acoustic phonon modes intersect, driving strong hybridization for low-loss technologies.

AI.tldr: 通过研究尖晶石铁氧体中Al/Li的位点有序化，揭示其驱动的亚铁磁绝缘态可通过抑制费米面态密度并利用磁振子-声子强杂化来降低磁阻尼。
AI.motivation: 磁振子学（magnonics）的核心挑战是：在理解自旋-晶格相互作用的同时，最小化磁阻尼。
AI.method: 对尖晶石铁氧体进行Al/Li位点特异有序化调控；使用第一性原理（Ab initio）计算，分析声学模式与四面体/八面体位点选择性的光学模式。
AI.result: Al/Li位点有序化驱动形成亚铁磁绝缘态，淬灭费米能级处的态密度；揭示低频磁振子与声学声子模式相交并发生强杂化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从微观层面理解了取代驱动的自旋动力学，强磁振子-声子杂化为低损耗磁振子技术提供了途径。

title: First-principles theory of phonon renormalization from nonlinear electron-phonon interactions
summary: Electron-phonon interactions renormalize phonon frequencies and lifetimes and are central to the dynamical properties of solids. While these effects are usually described within linear electron-phonon coupling, the role of nonlinear electron-phonon interactions for phonon properties remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study phonon renormalization arising from the long-range linear one-electron-one-phonon and the nonlinear one-electron-two-phonon interactions within a diagrammatic framework. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. In both materials, the two interaction channels renormalize the phonon spectrum in qualitatively distinct ways. The linear contribution is sharply localized near the Brillouin-zone center, whereas the nonlinear process couples an incoming phonon to other branches throughout the spectrum. As a result, it renormalizes phonons across the entire Brillouin-zone, with a pronounced temperature dependence governed by the thermal occupation of those branches. This behavior provides a clean experimental signature of the one-electron-two-phonon coupling. While the nonlinear phonon renormalization is small in LiF, it is somewhat larger in KTaO$_3$, which we attribute to its greater number of thermally populated phonon branches at room temperature. Our results establish a general framework to assess nonlinear electron-phonon effects on the phonon properties in materials with stronger lattice fluctuations, including soft semiconductors such as lead-halide perovskites.

AI.tldr: 本文在量子图框架下研究长程线性单电子-单声子与非线性单电子-双声子相互作用引起的声子重整化，从第一性原理计算了LiF和KTaO3两种极性半导体的自能图，发现线性和非线性通道对声子谱的重整化方式定性不同。
AI.motivation: 电子-声子相互作用通常在线性耦合框架内描述，而非线性电子-声子相互作用对声子性质（频率与寿命重整化）的影响尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在费曼图框架下推导依赖于化学势和温度的自能图，包含长程线性单电子-单声子项和非线性单电子-双声子项，并对LiF和KTaO3进行第一性原理计算。
AI.result: 两种通道的重整化行为定性不同：线性贡献集中在布里渊区中心附近，而非线性过程将入射声子与其他声子支耦合，重整化遍及整个布里渊区并表现出由声子支热占据决定强烈的温度依赖。非线性效应在LiF中较小，在KTaO3中较大（因其室温下热占据声子支更多）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了评估非线性电子-声子效应对声子性质影响的通用框架，为研究具有强晶格涨落的材料（如铅卤钙钛矿等软半导体）提供了方法基础。

title: A Gaussian process coarse-grained potential for Na-montmorillonite
summary: Hydraulic transport in compacted bentonite is diffusion-controlled and governed by the hydration and microstructure of sodium montmorillonite (Na-MMT). Experiments cannot resolve how platelet interactions govern pore structure, transport and stiffness, while existing coarse-grained models smooth hydration oscillations or require manual corrections. We develop a tabulated potential combining Morse interactions between platelet centre and edge sites with a Gaussian process regression correction trained on all-atom potentials of mean force. It captures the hydration-induced complexity of the potential-of-mean-force profiles, including the three-water (3-W) hydration minimum and transfers across geometries, layer-charge variants and unseen configurations. Applied to monodisperse and polydisperse Na-MMT assemblies at dry densities of 0.8-1.3 g cm^-3, the model captures the 3-W to 1-W transition, loss of non-interlayer porosity and evolution of pore structure, random-walk tortuosity, diffusion and stiffness. Predicted diffusion agrees with compacted Na-bentonite measurements.

AI.tldr: 该文开发了一种表格化粗粒化势（Morse相互作用+高斯过程回归校正），准确捕捉Na-MMT水化引起的PMF复杂性，并将其用于预测压实膨润土的孔结构、扩散与刚度。
AI.motivation: 压实膨润土的水力输运受扩散控制，由Na-MMT的水化与微观结构决定。实验无法解析片层相互作用如何控制孔结构、输运和刚度，而现有粗粒化模型会平滑水化振荡或需要人工校正。
AI.method: 构建表格化势：片层中心与边缘位点间采用Morse相互作用，并加入以全原子平均力势（PMF）训练的高斯过程回归校正；应用于0.8–1.3 g cm⁻³干密度的单分散与多分散Na-MMT集合体。
AI.result: 该势能再现PMF曲线中的三水（3-W）水化极小值，并可迁移至不同几何、层电荷变体及未见构型；模拟捕捉到3-W→1-W转变、层间外孔隙损失、孔结构演化、随机游走迂曲度、扩散与刚度，预测扩散与压实Na-膨润土实测值吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该粗粒化模型无需人工校正即可统一描述Na-MMT水化、微观结构与输运/力学性质，为压实膨润土的水力输运预测提供了可靠工具。
